sentences.zh: 完顏仲元

translations.literal: Wanyan Zhongyuan
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Zhongyuan

sentences.zh: 完顏仲元，本姓郭氏，中都人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Zhongyuan, originally surnamed Guo, was a native of Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Zhongyuan was born with the surname Guo and came from Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 大安中，李雄募兵，仲元與完顏阿鄰俱應募，數有功。

translations.literal: During the Da'an period, Li Xiong recruited troops; Zhongyuan and Wanyan Alin both answered the call and repeatedly achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Da'an era, when Li Xiong raised troops, Zhongyuan and Wanyan Alin both enlisted and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，與阿鄰俱累功至節度。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou, he and Alin both accumulated merit until they reached the rank of military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: By the third year of Zhenyou, he and Alin had risen through accumulated merit to the rank of jiedushi.

sentences.zh: 仲元為永定軍節度使，賜姓完顏氏。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan became military commissioner of the Yongding Army and was granted the surname Wanyan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan was appointed jiedushi of the Yongding Army and received the imperial surname Wanyan.

sentences.zh: 仲元在當時兵最強，號「花帽軍」，人呼為「郭大相公」，以與阿鄰相別。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan's troops were at that time the strongest; they were called the "Flower-Cap Army," and people addressed him as "Grandee Guo" to distinguish him from Alin.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his force was the strongest in the field; it was known as the Flower-Cap Army, and people called him Grandee Guo to set him apart from Alin.

sentences.zh: 頃之，兼本路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Before long he also held the concurrent post of pacification commissioner for his circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was also made pacification commissioner of his circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月，遙授知河間府事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was appointed in absentia as prefect of Hejian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he received a remote appointment as prefect of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 數月，改知濟南府事，權山東東路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Several months later he was transferred to prefect of Jinan and acting deputy pacification commissioner of Shandong East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A few months later he was reassigned as prefect of Jinan and acting deputy pacification commissioner for Shandong East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年，山東乏糧，仲元軍三萬欲于黃河之側或陝右分屯，上書乞補京官，且言恢復河朔之策，當詣闕面陳。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyou, Shandong lacked grain; Zhongyuan's army of thirty thousand wished to divide and encamp on the banks of the Yellow River or in western Shaanxi. He submitted a memorial requesting appointment to a capital office and also set forth a strategy for recovering the Hebei north, saying he ought to come to court and present it in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyou, with Shandong short of grain, Zhongyuan's thirty-thousand-man army proposed splitting up to camp along the Yellow River or in western Shaanxi. He memorialized the throne asking for a capital appointment and outlining a plan to recover the north of Hebei, which he said he should present in person at court.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「卿兄弟鳩集義旅，所在立功，忠義之誠，皎然可見。

translations.literal: An edict said: "You brothers have gathered righteous troops and achieved merit wherever you have gone; your loyalty and righteousness are plainly evident.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's edict read: "You and your brother have rallied loyal volunteers and won merit wherever you fight; your devotion is plain for all to see.

sentences.zh: 朕以參政侯摯與卿素厚，命於彼中行省，應悉朕心。

translations.literal: Because Grand Councilor Hou Zhi has long been close to you, I have ordered him to serve in the provincial administration there; he should fully understand my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Hou Zhi has long been close to you, and I have sent him to administer that region on my behalf; he will convey my wishes.

sentences.zh: 卿求入見，其意固嘉，東平方危，正賴卿等相為聲援，俟兵勢稍緩，即徙軍附河屯駐，此時卿來，蓋未晚也。

translations.literal: Your wish to come for an audience is indeed commendable, but the east is in peril and now depends on you and others for mutual support. Wait until the military situation eases somewhat, then move your army to camp along the river; at that time your coming will not yet be late.
translations.idiomatic: Your desire to come to court is admirable, but the east is in crisis and needs you here as a bulwark. When the fighting eases, move your troops to camp along the river; then it will not be too late for you to come.

sentences.zh: 尚思戮力，朕不汝忘。」

translations.literal: Continue to strive together; I shall not forget you."
translations.idiomatic: Keep exerting yourselves together, and I will not forget what you have done."

sentences.zh: 未幾，改河北宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to deputy pacification commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was made deputy pacification commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 仲元部將李霆等積功至刺史、提控，仲元奏賜金牌，霆等皆為名將，功名與仲元相埒。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan's subordinate generals Li Ting and others accumulated merit until they reached the ranks of prefect and ti-kong. Zhongyuan memorialized that they be granted gold plaques; Ting and the others all became famous generals whose achievements rivaled Zhongyuan's.
translations.idiomatic: Among Zhongyuan's officers, Li Ting and others rose through merit to the ranks of prefect and ti-kong. Zhongyuan petitioned that they receive gold plaques; they became renowned commanders whose fame matched his own.

sentences.zh: 仲元屢有功，以本職為從宜招撫使，計約從坦等軍圖恢復。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan repeatedly achieved merit and, while retaining his original post, was made flexible pacification commissioner to coordinate with Congtan's army and others in planning recovery.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated victories he kept his existing post but was also made flexible pacification commissioner, charged with coordinating Congtan's forces and others in plans to retake lost territory.

sentences.zh: 詔以仲元軍猥多，差為三等，上等備征伐，中下給戍守，懦弱者皆罷去。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that because Zhongyuan's army was excessively large, it be divided into three grades: the upper grade for campaigns, the middle and lower for garrison duty, and the cowardly all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zhongyuan's army had grown unwieldy, an edict divided it into three tiers: the top tier for campaigns, the middle and lower for garrison duty, and the timid were all discharged.

sentences.zh: 紅祆賊千餘人據漣水縣，仲元遣提控婁室率兵擊破之，斬首數百，敗祝春，擒郭偉，餘眾奔潰，遂複漣水縣。

translations.literal: More than a thousand Red Turban rebels occupied Lianshui County. Zhongyuan sent ti-kong Lou Shi leading troops to defeat them, beheading several hundred, defeating Zhu Chun, capturing Guo Wei; the rest fled in rout, and Lianshui County was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: When more than a thousand Red Turban rebels seized Lianshui County, Zhongyuan sent ti-kong Lou Shi to crush them. Several hundred were beheaded; Zhu Chun was defeated and Guo Wei captured; the rest scattered, and Lianshui was retaken.

sentences.zh: 仲元兼單州經略使，婁室遷兩階，升職一等。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan concurrently became Shandong circuit commissioner; Lou Shi was promoted two ranks and advanced one grade in office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan was also made commissioner of Shanzhou circuit, while Lou Shi was promoted two ranks and advanced one grade.

sentences.zh: 未幾，仲元遙授知歸德府事。

translations.literal: Before long Zhongyuan was appointed in absentia as prefect of Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he received a remote appointment as prefect of Guide.

sentences.zh: 是歲十月，徙軍盧氏，改商州經略使，權元帥右都監。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year he moved his army to Lushi, was made Shangzhou circuit commissioner, and acting right director of the Marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: That October he shifted his army to Lushi, was named Shangzhou circuit commissioner, and made acting right director of the Marshalate.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「商、虢、潼關，實相連屬，卿思為萬全之計。」

translations.literal: An edict said: "Shang, Guo, and Tong Pass are in truth linked together; you should devise a plan that leaves nothing to chance."
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed him: "Shang, Guo, and Tong Pass form one continuous line of defense; devise a plan that leaves nothing to chance."

sentences.zh: 未幾，潼關失守，仲元軍趨商、虢，複至嵩、汝，皆弗及。

translations.literal: Before long Tong Pass fell; Zhongyuan's army hurried toward Shang and Guo, then again toward Song and Ru, but reached none of them in time.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tong Pass fell. Zhongyuan rushed toward Shang and Guo, then toward Song and Ru, but arrived too late each time.

sentences.zh: 仲元上書曰：「去年六月，臣嘗請於朝廷，乞選名將督諸軍，臣得推鋒，身先士卒，糧儲不繼，竟不果行。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan submitted a memorial saying: "Last year in the sixth month I once requested of the court that a famous general be chosen to command all armies while I could press the attack and lead the troops in person; supplies did not keep up, and in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan wrote: "Last June I asked the court to appoint a renowned commander over all forces while I led the vanguard in person. Supplies failed, and the plan never went forward.

sentences.zh: 今將坐甲待敵，則師老財殫，日就困弊。」

translations.literal: If we now sit with armor on waiting for the enemy, the army will grow weary and funds exhausted, daily falling into distress."
translations.idiomatic: If we now sit idle in armor waiting for the enemy, the army will wear out, funds run dry, and our position weaken day by day."

sentences.zh: 其大概欲伐西夏以張兵勢。

translations.literal: In general he wished to attack Western Xia to expand military strength.
translations.idiomatic: In essence he proposed attacking Western Xia to build up military momentum.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「陝西一路，最為重地，潼關、禁坑及商州諸隘，俱當預備。

translations.literal: He also said: "The Shaanxi circuit is the most critical territory; Tong Pass, Jinkeng, and the passes of Shangzhou all ought to be prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote: "The Shaanxi circuit is the most vital sector; Tong Pass, Jinkeng, and the passes of Shangzhou must all be garrisoned in advance.

sentences.zh: 向者中都，居庸最為要害，乃由小嶺、紫荊繞出，我軍腹背受兵，卒不能守。

translations.literal: Formerly at Zhongdu, Juyong was the most strategic point, yet the enemy came around by way of Xiaoling and Zijing; our army was attacked front and rear and in the end could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhongdu, Juyong had been the key defense, yet the enemy slipped through Xiaoling and Zijing; our troops were caught front and rear and could not hold.

sentences.zh: 近日由禁坑出，遂失潼關。

translations.literal: Recently they came out through Jinkeng, and thus Tong Pass was lost.
translations.idiomatic: More recently they emerged through Jinkeng, and Tong Pass was lost.

sentences.zh: 可選精兵分地戍之。」

translations.literal: Elite troops may be selected and stationed in divisions to guard them."
translations.idiomatic: Pick elite troops and post them at each pass in turn."

sentences.zh: 其後乃置秦、藍守禦，及用兵西夏矣。

translations.literal: Afterward garrisons were established at Qin and Lan, and troops were also deployed against Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: The court then set up defenses at Qin and Lan and opened campaigns against Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 完顏阿鄰

translations.literal: Wanyan Alin
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Alin

sentences.zh: 完顏阿鄰，本姓郭氏，以功俱賜姓完顏。

translations.literal: Wanyan Alin, originally surnamed Guo, was granted the surname Wanyan together with others for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Alin was born a Guo; he and his comrades received the surname Wanyan for their service.

sentences.zh: 大安中，李雄募兵，阿鄰與完顏仲元等俱應募，數有功。

translations.literal: During the Da'an period, Li Xiong recruited troops; Alin and Wanyan Zhongyuan and others all answered the call and repeatedly achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Da'an era, when Li Xiong raised troops, Alin enlisted alongside Wanyan Zhongyuan and others and won repeated victories.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，遷通州防禦使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, he was transferred to defender of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong acceded, Alin was made defender of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣宗遷汴，阿鄰改同知河間府事兼清州防禦使，將所部兵駐清、滄，控扼山東。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian, Alin was made vice prefect of Hejian and concurrent defender of Qingzhou; he led his troops to garrison Qing and Cang, controlling Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: When the court moved to Bian, Alin became vice prefect of Hejian and defender of Qingzhou, stationing his troops at Qing and Cang to hold Shandong.

sentences.zh: 遷橫海軍節度使，賜以國姓。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Henghai Army and granted the imperial surname.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to jiedushi of the Henghai Army and given the imperial surname.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰與山東路宣撫副使顏盞天澤不相能，詔阿鄰當與天澤共濟國事，無執偏見，妄分彼此。

translations.literal: Alin and Yanzhantianze, deputy pacification commissioner of the Shandong circuit, did not get along; an edict ordered that Alin should join Tianze in serving the state, without clinging to prejudice or recklessly dividing into sides.
translations.idiomatic: Alin clashed with Yanzhantianze, deputy pacification commissioner of Shandong. An edict told him to work with Tianze for the realm and not let personal bias divide them.

sentences.zh: 尋改泰定軍節度使、山東西路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Before long he was made military commissioner of the Taiding Army and pacification commissioner of Shandong West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was named jiedushi of the Taiding Army and pacification commissioner of Shandong West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 是時，仲元亦積功勞，知濟南府，賜姓完顏，與阿鄰俱加從宜招撫使，詔書獎諭，且令計約涿州刺史從坦等軍恢復中都。

translations.literal: At that time Zhongyuan had also accumulated merit and labor, was prefect of Jinan, and granted the surname Wanyan; he and Alin were both made flexible pacification commissioners. An edict praised them and also ordered them to coordinate with Congtan, prefect of Zhuo, and other armies to recover Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: By then Zhongyuan had earned high distinction as prefect of Jinan and had received the surname Wanyan. He and Alin were both named flexible pacification commissioners; the court praised them and told them to join forces with Zhuo prefect Congtan and others to retake Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 於是，仲元、阿鄰部兵猥多，詔以三等差第之，上等備征伐，中下戍守，懦弱者罷去，量給地以贍其家。

translations.literal: Thereupon, because the troops under Zhongyuan and Alin were excessively numerous, an edict divided them into three grades: the upper for campaigns, the middle and lower for garrison, the cowardly dismissed, and land allotted in measure to support their families.
translations.idiomatic: Because the armies of Zhongyuan and Alin had grown too large, an edict sorted them into three tiers for campaign, garrison, or discharge, with land grants to support the families of those released.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰所部「黃鶴袖軍」駐魚台者，桀驁不法，掠平民，劫商旅，道路不通，有司乞徙于滕州。

translations.literal: Among Alin's troops, the "Yellow Crane Sleeve Army" stationed at Yutai was insubordinate and lawless, plundering civilians and robbing merchants; the roads were impassable, and the authorities requested they be moved to Tengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Alin's Yellow Crane Sleeve Army at Yutai grew unruly, looting civilians and merchants until travel was unsafe. Officials asked to relocate them to Tengzhou.

sentences.zh: 詔阿鄰就處置之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Alin to go and deal with the matter on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: The court told Alin to handle the matter himself.

sentences.zh: 頃之，破紅祆賊郝定于泗水縣柘溝村，生擒郝定，送京師斬之。

translations.literal: Before long he defeated the Red Turban rebel Hao Ding at Zhegou Village in Sishui County, captured Hao Ding alive, and sent him to the capital for execution.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he routed the Red Turban leader Hao Ding at Zhegou in Sishui County, took him alive, and sent him to the capital for execution.

sentences.zh: 近制，賜本朝姓者，凡以千人敗敵三千者賜及緦麻以上，敗二千人以上者賜及大功以上，敗千人以上賜止其家。

translations.literal: A recent regulation on granting the dynasty's surname held that whoever with a thousand men defeated three thousand enemies might extend the grant through the sizong degree of mourning; defeating more than two thousand extended it through the dagong degree; defeating more than a thousand extended it only to one's household.
translations.idiomatic: A recent rule held that recipients of the imperial surname could extend it to kin by the scale of victory: defeating three thousand with a thousand men reached distant cousins; two thousand reached closer kin; one thousand reached only the immediate household.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰既賜姓，以兄守楫及從父兄弟為請。

translations.literal: After Alin received the surname, he requested it for his elder brother Shouji and his father's younger brothers' sons.
translations.idiomatic: Once Alin had the surname, he petitioned for his elder brother Shouji and his paternal cousins.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏阿鄰功止賜一家，宣宗特詔許之。

translations.literal: The chief ministers reported that Alin's merit warranted granting the surname to only one household, but Emperor Xuanzong issued a special edict permitting it.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers said Alin's merit covered only his own household, but Emperor Xuanzong specially approved the wider grant.

sentences.zh: 至是仲元上奏曰：「臣頃在軍旅，才立微功，遽蒙天恩，賜之國姓，非臣殺身所能仰報。

translations.literal: At this time Zhongyuan submitted a memorial saying: "I was lately in the army and had only achieved slight merit when I suddenly received Heaven's grace and was granted the imperial surname; it is not something I could repay by giving my life.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan then memorialized: "I had only just won modest merit in the field when Heaven granted me the imperial surname—a debt no death of mine could repay.

sentences.zh: 族兄徐州譏察副使僧喜、前汾州酒同監三喜、前解州鹽管勾添章、守興平縣監酒添福猶姓郭氏。

translations.literal: My clansman Sengxi, vice commissioner of inspection at Xuzhou, the former wine supervisor of Fenzhou Sanxi, the former salt controller of Jiezhou Tianzhang, and Tianfu, keeper of the wine monopoly at Xingping County, still bear the surname Guo.
translations.idiomatic: My kinsmen Sengxi, vice inspection commissioner at Xuzhou; Sanxi, former wine supervisor at Fenzhou; Tianzhang, former salt controller at Jiezhou; and Tianfu, wine monopoly officer at Xingping—all still bear the surname Guo.

sentences.zh: 念臣與僧喜等昔同一家，今為兩族，完顏阿鄰與臣同功，皇恩所加並及本族，僧喜等四人乞依此例。」

translations.literal: Considering that Sengxi and I were once one family and are now two clans, while Wanyan Alin and I share the same merit and the imperial grace extended to our whole clan, I beg that these four men, Sengxi and the others, be granted by the same precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Sengxi and I were once one family and are now split; Wanyan Alin won the same honor and the grant reached his whole clan. I ask that these four kinsmen receive the surname on the same terms."

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: Permission was denied.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 改輝州經略使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Huizhou circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Alin was made commissioner of Huizhou circuit.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰有眾萬五千，詔分五千隸東平行省，其眾泣訴雲：「我曹以國家多難，奮義相從，捐田宅，離親戚，轉戰至此，誓同立功，偕還鄉里。

translations.literal: Alin had fifteen thousand men; an edict divided off five thousand to be placed under the Eastern Ping provincial administration. His troops wept and pleaded: "We, because the state faced many hardships, rose in righteous fellowship, gave up fields and houses, left kin, and fought our way here, vowing to win merit together and return home together.
translations.idiomatic: Alin commanded fifteen thousand men when an edict detached five thousand for the Eastern Ping province. His soldiers wept: "We left our lands and families to follow you in the state's hour of need, swearing to win glory together and go home together.

sentences.zh: 今將分配他軍，心實艱苦。

translations.literal: Now we are to be assigned to other armies; our hearts are truly anguished.
translations.idiomatic: To be split up now breaks our hearts.

sentences.zh: 乞以全軍分駐懷、衛、輝州之間，捍蔽大河，惟受阿鄰節制。」

translations.literal: We beg that the whole army be divided in garrison between Huai, Wei, and Huizhou to shield the Great River, subject only to Alin's command."
translations.idiomatic: Keep the whole force posted between Huai, Wei, and Huizhou to guard the Yellow River, under Alin alone."

sentences.zh: 阿鄰亦不欲分之，因以為請。

translations.literal: Alin also did not wish them divided and therefore made the same request.
translations.idiomatic: Alin, who did not want the split either, backed their petition.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏：「若遂聽之，非唯東平失備，他將仿效，皆不可使矣。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers reported: "If this is granted, not only will Eastern Ping lose its defenses; other generals will imitate it, and none of this can be allowed."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers argued: "If we agree, Eastern Ping is left undefended and every commander will demand the same—this cannot be allowed."

sentences.zh: 宣宗以為然。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 加遙授知河南府事，應援陝西。

translations.literal: He was further appointed in absentia as prefect of Henan and sent to reinforce Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He received a remote appointment as prefect of Henan and marched to reinforce Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰將兵八千，西赴至潼關，聞京兆已被圍，游騎至華州，陝西行院欲令阿鄰駐軍商、虢，拒東向之路。

translations.literal: Alin led eight thousand troops westward as far as Tong Pass; he heard that Jingzhao was already besieged and that enemy scouts had reached Huazhou. The Shaanxi branch administration wished Alin to garrison Shang and Guo to block the road eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Alin marched west with eight thousand men to Tong Pass, learned Jingzhao was besieged and enemy scouts had reached Huazhou, and was told to hold Shang and Guo to block the eastern approach.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰上奏：「臣本援陝西，遇難而止，豈人臣之節？

translations.literal: Alin submitted a memorial: "I was sent to reinforce Shaanxi; to halt when disaster strikes—is that a subject's duty?
translations.idiomatic: Alin wrote: "I was sent to save Shaanxi. To stop at the first crisis—is that how a loyal officer acts?

sentences.zh: 夫自古用兵，步騎相參，乃可以得志。

translations.literal: From antiquity in employing troops, infantry and cavalry have complemented each other; only then can one succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity, campaigns succeed only when infantry and cavalry work together.

sentences.zh: 今乃各有所屬，臨難不救，互分彼此。

translations.literal: Now each has its own commander; facing disaster they do not rescue one another, recklessly dividing into sides.
translations.idiomatic: Now every unit has its own master; at crisis no one helps the other, and commanders cling to their own patches.

sentences.zh: 今臣所統皆步卒，願賜馬軍千人，則京兆之圍不足解矣。」

translations.literal: Those I now command are all foot soldiers; I beg a thousand horse troops, and then the siege of Jingzhao would be nothing to relieve."
translations.idiomatic: I command only foot soldiers. Give me a thousand cavalry and the siege of Jingzhao will be easy to break."

sentences.zh: 宣宗謂皇太子曰：「阿鄰赴難不回，固善矣。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong said to the crown prince: "Alin's rushing to disaster without turning back is indeed admirable.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the crown prince: "Alin's willingness to press on is admirable.

sentences.zh: 而軍勢單弱，且駐內地以觀事變，並以虢州兵五千付之，使乘隙而進，卿以此意諭之也。」

translations.literal: Yet his force is thin and weak; let him for the present garrison the interior and watch how events develop, and also give him five thousand troops from Guozhou to advance when an opening appears. Explain this intent to him."
translations.idiomatic: But his force is too weak. Have him hold the interior for now, give him Guozhou's five thousand troops, and let him advance when he sees an opening. Convey that to him."

sentences.zh: 完顏霆

translations.literal: Wanyan Ting
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Ting

sentences.zh: 完顏霆，本姓李氏，中都寶坻人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Ting, originally surnamed Li, was a native of Baodi in Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Ting was born a Li from Baodi near Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 粗知書，善騎射，輕財好施，得鄉曲之譽。

translations.literal: He had rough knowledge of books, was skilled in riding and archery, treated wealth lightly and delighted in giving, and won praise in his district.
translations.idiomatic: He had some schooling, excelled at riding and archery, was generous with his wealth, and won local esteem.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，縣人共推霆為四鄉部頭。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou, the people of the county together chose Ting as head of the four districts.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou the county chose him head of the four districts.

sentences.zh: 霆招集離散，糾合義兵，眾賴以安。

translations.literal: Ting gathered the scattered, mustered righteous troops, and the people relied on him for security.
translations.idiomatic: He rallied the displaced, organized volunteer forces, and brought the region a measure of safety.

sentences.zh: 招撫司奏其事，遷兩官。

translations.literal: The Pacification Office reported the matter, and he was promoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Office reported his work and he was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 霆與弟雲率眾數千巡邏固安、永清間，遙授寶坻縣丞，充義軍都統。

translations.literal: Ting and his younger brother Yun led several thousand men patrolling between Gu'an and Yongqing; he was appointed in absentia as assistant magistrate of Baodi and made commander-in-chief of the righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: Ting and his brother Yun led several thousand men on patrol between Gu'an and Yongqing. He received a remote appointment as Baodi assistant magistrate and became commander of the volunteer army.

sentences.zh: 劉璋說霆使出降，霆縛送經略司。

translations.literal: Liu Zhang urged Ting to surrender; Ting bound him and sent him to the circuit administration.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zhang urged him to surrender, Ting bound him and handed him to the circuit authorities.

sentences.zh: 遷三階，攝寶坻令，升都提控，遙授同知通州軍州事。

translations.literal: He was promoted three ranks, acted as magistrate of Baodi, rose to metropolitan ti-kong, and was appointed in absentia as vice commissioner of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three ranks, acted as Baodi magistrate, became metropolitan ti-kong, and received a remote appointment as vice commissioner of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 中都食盡，霆遣軍分護清、滄河路，召募賈船通餉道。

translations.literal: When Zhongdu ran out of food, Ting sent troops to guard the river routes of Qing and Cang and recruited merchant vessels to open the supply line.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongdu's grain ran out, he posted troops along the Qing and Cang waterways and hired merchant ships to keep supplies moving.

sentences.zh: 遙授同知清州防禦事，從河北路宣撫使完顏仲元保清、滄。

translations.literal: He was appointed in absentia as vice defender of Qingzhou and, following Hebei pacification commissioner Wanyan Zhongyuan, defended Qing and Cang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice defender of Qingzhou in absentia and, under Wanyan Zhongyuan, helped hold Qing and Cang.

sentences.zh: 遙授通州刺史、河北東路行軍提控，佩金牌。

translations.literal: He was appointed in absentia as prefect of Tongzhou and campaign ti-kong of Hebei East Circuit, wearing a gold plaque.
translations.idiomatic: He became prefect of Tongzhou and campaign ti-kong of Hebei East Circuit in absentia and received a gold plaque.

sentences.zh: 舊制，宣撫副使乃佩金牌，仲元奏：「臣軍三萬，管軍官三人，皆至五品，乞各賜金牌。」

translations.literal: By old regulation only deputy pacification commissioners wore gold plaques. Zhongyuan memorialized: "My army is thirty thousand; the three officers commanding troops have all reached the fifth rank; I beg that each be granted a gold plaque."
translations.idiomatic: By custom only deputy pacification commissioners wore gold plaques. Zhongyuan wrote: "My army numbers thirty thousand; my three field commanders are fifth rank or higher—grant each a gold plaque."

sentences.zh: 廷議霆輩忠勇絕人，遂與之。

translations.literal: The court debated that Ting and his fellows were loyal and brave beyond others, and granted them.
translations.idiomatic: The court judged Ting and his comrades uniquely loyal and brave, and approved the request.

sentences.zh: 改大名路提控，複取玉田、三河、香河三縣。

translations.literal: He was made ti-kong of Daming Circuit and recovered the three counties of Yutian, Sanhe, and Xianghe.
translations.idiomatic: He became ti-kong of Daming Circuit and retook Yutian, Sanhe, and Xianghe.

sentences.zh: 徙屯濱、棣、淄，留副將孫江守滄州。

translations.literal: He moved his camp to Bin, Di, and Zi, leaving his deputy Sun Jiang to defend Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He shifted camp to Bin, Di, and Zi, leaving deputy Sun Jiang at Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 江以滄州降于王楫，而江將兵圍觀州。

translations.literal: Jiang surrendered Cangzhou to Wang Ji, yet Jiang also led troops to besiege Guanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang surrendered Cangzhou to Wang Ji while still leading troops against Guanzhou.

sentences.zh: 霆乃詐作書與孫江，約同取滄州者。

translations.literal: Ting then forged a letter to Sun Jiang, as if arranging together to retake Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ting forged a letter to Sun Jiang, as if plotting a joint assault on Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 王楫得其書，果疑孫江與霆有謀，召江還，殺之。

translations.literal: Wang Ji obtained the letter and indeed suspected that Sun Jiang and Ting were in conspiracy; he summoned Jiang back and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji seized the letter, suspected a plot between Jiang and Ting, recalled Jiang, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 霆乃定觀州而還。

translations.literal: Ting then secured Guanzhou and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Ting then secured Guanzhou and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 進官三階，充濱、棣行軍都提控。

translations.literal: He was advanced three ranks and made metropolitan campaign ti-kong of Bin and Di.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted three ranks and made metropolitan campaign ti-kong of Bin and Di.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遙授同知益都府事，加宣差都提控，遷棣州防禦使，賜姓完顏氏，屯海州。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed in absentia as vice prefect of Yidu, made imperial commissioner metropolitan ti-kong, transferred to defender of Dizhou, granted the surname Wanyan, and garrisoned Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was vice prefect of Yidu in absentia, imperial commissioner metropolitan ti-kong, defender of Dizhou, granted the surname Wanyan, and posted at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 俄權單州經略司事，充宣差總領都提控。

translations.literal: Shortly he acted as Shanzhou circuit commissioner and served as imperial commissioner overall metropolitan ti-kong.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as Shanzhou circuit commissioner and overall metropolitan ti-kong under imperial commission.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，泰安、滕、兗土寇蜂起，東平行省侯摯遣霆率兵討之，降石花五、夏全餘黨二萬人，老幼五萬口，充權海州經略副使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding, local bandits rose like bees in Tai'an, Teng, and Yan; Eastern Ping provincial commissioner Hou Zhi sent Ting to lead troops against them. He received the surrender of twenty thousand remnants of Shihua Wu and Xia Quan, with fifty thousand old and young, and was made acting deputy circuit commissioner of Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Xingding 1, bandits swarmed Tai'an, Teng, and Yan. Hou Zhi sent Ting to suppress them; he accepted the surrender of twenty thousand followers of Shihua Wu and Xia Quan and fifty thousand dependents, and was named acting deputy commissioner of Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 紅祆賊於忙兒寇海州，霆擊走之。

translations.literal: Red Turban rebels under Yu Mang'er raided Haizhou; Ting attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Red Turban rebels under Yu Mang'er raided Haizhou; Ting drove them back.

sentences.zh: 二年，宋高太尉兵三萬駐朐山。

translations.literal: In the second year, Grand Marshal Gao of Song with thirty thousand troops encamped at Qushan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Song Grand Marshal Gao camped at Qushan with thirty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 霆軍乏糧，采野菜麥苗雜食之。

translations.literal: Ting's army lacked grain and gathered wild vegetables and wheat shoots to eat in mixture.
translations.idiomatic: Ting's army ran short of grain and lived on wild greens and young wheat.

sentences.zh: 宋兵柵朐山，下隔湖港，霆作港中暗橋，遣萬戶胡仲珪、副統劉斌率死士由暗橋登山，霆率兵四千人趨山下，約以昏時舉火為期，上下夾擊，宋兵大敗，墜澗溺水死者不可勝計，斬高太尉、彭元帥于陣，餘眾潰去。

translations.literal: Song troops fortified Qushan, separated below by the lake harbor. Ting built a hidden bridge in the harbor and sent wanhu Hu Zhonggui and vice-commander Liu Bin leading dare-to-die men up the mountain by the hidden bridge, while Ting led four thousand troops down the slope. They agreed to signal with fire at dusk; attacked from above and below, the Song army was utterly defeated; those who fell into ravines and drowned were beyond counting; Grand Marshal Gao and Marshal Peng were beheaded on the field, and the rest fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: The Song held Qushan above a lake harbor. Ting built a concealed bridge and sent Hu Zhonggui and Liu Bin with picked men across it to the heights, while he led four thousand down the slope. At dusk they lit the signal fires and struck from both sides. The Song army collapsed; countless men fell into ravines and drowned; Gao and Marshal Peng were slain in the field; the rest fled.

sentences.zh: 遷安化軍節度使，經略副使如故。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military commissioner of the Anhua Army, retaining his post as deputy circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was made jiedushi of the Anhua Army while keeping his deputy commissioner post.

sentences.zh: 以其子為符寶典書。

translations.literal: His son was made director of the talisman and treasure office.
translations.idiomatic: His son was appointed director of the imperial seals and regalia.

sentences.zh: 逾月，宋兵複至，霆逆戰，駐兵城外。

translations.literal: After more than a month, Song troops came again; Ting met them in battle and stationed his troops outside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: A month later the Song returned; Ting met them in battle with his force camped outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 夜半，宋人乘虛逾城而入。

translations.literal: At midnight the Song took advantage of a gap and climbed over the walls to enter.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the Song slipped over the walls into the city.

sentences.zh: 經略使阿不罕奴失剌率兵扼戰，都統溫蒂罕五兒、副統蒲察永成、蒲察只魯身先士卒，殺二百餘人，城賴以完。

translations.literal: Circuit commissioner Abuhan Nushila led troops to block and fight; metropolitan commander Wendihan Wu'er, vice-commanders Pucha Yongcheng and Pucha Zhilu led from the front; more than two hundred were killed, and the city was preserved thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Abuhan Nushila held the line; Wendihan Wu'er, Pucha Yongcheng, and Pucha Zhilu led from the front, killed more than two hundred Song soldiers, and the city held.

sentences.zh: 詔五兒等各遷兩階。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu'er and the others each advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The throne promoted Wu'er and his fellows each by two ranks.

sentences.zh: 烏古論長壽

translations.literal: Wugulun Changshou
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Changshou

sentences.zh: 烏古論長壽，臨洮府第五將突門族人也。

translations.literal: Wugulun Changshou was a native of the Tumen clan of the Fifth Command of Lintao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Changshou came from the Tumen clan attached to the Fifth Command of Lintao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 本姓包氏，襲父永本族都管。

translations.literal: His original surname was Bao; he inherited his father Yong's post as commander of the native clan.
translations.idiomatic: Born to the Bao clan, he succeeded his father Yong as commander of their native band.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，充緋翮翅軍千戶，取褷川寨及祐州、宕昌、辛城子，以功進官二階。

translations.literal: During the Taihe campaign against Song, he served as chiliarch of the Crimson-Winged Army, captured Qichuan Stockade and You, Dangchang, and Xinchengzi, and advanced two ranks for merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe war on Song he led a chiliarch of the Crimson-Winged Army, took Qichuan Stockade and You, Dangchang, and Xinchengzi, and rose two ranks for his deeds.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，夏人攻會州，統軍使署征行萬戶，升副統，與夏人戰於窄土峽，先登陷陣，賞銀五十兩。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhenyou, when Xi Xia attacked Huizhou, the army commissioner appointed him campaign wanhu; he was raised to vice-commander; at Zhaotu Gorge he was first to scale and break the line, and was rewarded fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou, when the Xia struck Huizhou, the army commissioner made him a campaign wanhu and then vice-commander; at Zhaotu Gorge he was first over the wall and through the enemy line, and received fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 戰東關堡，以功署都統，兼充安定、定西、保川、西寧軍馬都彈壓。

translations.literal: At Dongguan Fort he fought; for merit he was appointed metropolitan commander and concurrently made overall suppressor of cavalry and horse for the armies of Anding, Dingxi, Baochuan, and Xining.
translations.idiomatic: He fought at Dongguan Fort and, for merit, was named metropolitan commander while also overseeing horse and cavalry for the Anding, Dingxi, Baochuan, and Xining commands.

sentences.zh: 詔錄前後功，遙授同知隴州防禦事，世襲本族都巡檢。

translations.literal: An edict recorded his past and present achievements; he received by remote appointment the post of vice commissioner of Longzhou defense, and hereditary commander of his clan's patrol.
translations.idiomatic: The court registered his past and present service, gave him by remote appointment the vice defense commissionership of Longzhou, and let him inherit his clan's chief patrol post.

sentences.zh: 三年，賜今姓。

translations.literal: In the third year he was granted his present surname.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he received his present surname.

sentences.zh: 攻蘭州程陳僧，為先鋒都統。

translations.literal: Attacking Cheng Chenseng at Lanzhou, he served as vanguard metropolitan commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Cheng Chenseng at Lanzhou, he commanded the vanguard as metropolitan commander.

sentences.zh: 夏人圍監洮，扼渭源堡，內外不通。

translations.literal: Xi Xia besieged Jiantao, choked Weiyuan Fort, and cut off communication within and without.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia besieged Jiantao, blocked Weiyuan Fort, and severed all traffic in and out.

sentences.zh: 統軍司募人偵候臨洮消息，長壽應募，馘二人，擒一人，問得臨洮及夏兵事勢。

translations.literal: The army commissioner's office recruited scouts for Lintao news; Changshou answered the call, took two heads, captured one man, and learned the situation of Lintao and the Xia army.
translations.idiomatic: The army commissioner's office sought scouts for word from Lintao; Changshou volunteered, slew two men, took one prisoner, and learned how matters stood at Lintao and in the Xia camp.

sentences.zh: 以勞遷宣武將軍，遙授通遠軍節度副使。

translations.literal: For this labor he was transferred to General of Manifest Martiality and remotely appointed deputy military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: For the effort he was made General of Manifest Martiality and remotely appointed deputy commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 招降諸蕃族及熟羊寨秦州逋亡者。

translations.literal: He induced various fan clans and those who had fled from Qinzhou at Shuoyang Stockade to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He brought over various tribal groups and fugitives from Qinzhou who had been at Shuoyang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 複遷懷遠大將軍，升提控。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Grand General of Cherishing the Distance and promoted to tiju.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to Grand General of Cherishing the Distance and raised to tiju.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，夏人大入隴西，長壽拒戰，遷平涼府治中，兼節度副使，充宣差鞏州規措官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding, when Xi Xia swept deep into Longyou, Changshou resisted; he was made administrative aide of Pingliang Prefecture, also deputy military commissioner, and appointed special commissioner for planning at Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding the Xia poured into Longyou; Changshou held them off, became administrative aide of Pingliang, also deputy commissioner, and served as the court's special planning officer at Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 頃之，遙授同知鳳翔府事，兼同知通遠軍節度事，提控如故。

translations.literal: Before long he was remotely appointed vice prefect of Fengxiang and concurrently vice commissioner of the Tongyuan Army, while retaining his post as tiju.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was given by remote appointment the vice prefecture of Fengxiang and the vice commissionership of Tongyuan, while keeping his post as tiju.

sentences.zh: 興定二年，遷同知臨洮府事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xingding he was transferred to vice prefect of Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xingding he became vice prefect of Lintao.

sentences.zh: 與提控洮州刺史納蘭記僧分兵伐宋。

translations.literal: He joined tiju and Tao Prefecture inspector Nalan Jiseng in dividing forces to attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: He and the tiju Nalan Jiseng, inspector of Tao Prefecture, split their forces to strike Song.

sentences.zh: 長壽由鹽川鎮進兵，宋人守戍者走保馬頭山，合諸部族兵來拒。

translations.literal: Changshou advanced from Yanchuan Town; Song garrison troops fled to hold Matou Mountain and gathered tribal forces to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Changshou marched from Yanchuan Town; the Song garrison abandoned its posts for Matou Mountain and rallied tribal auxiliaries to meet him.

sentences.zh: 長壽擊敗之，複破其援兵四千於荔川寨。

translations.literal: Changshou defeated them and again smashed four thousand reinforcements at Lichuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Changshou routed them, then shattered four thousand reinforcements at Lichuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 即趨宕昌縣。

translations.literal: He then hurried to Dangchang County.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed on to Dangchang County.

sentences.zh: 破宋兵二千于八斜穀，拔宕昌縣，進攻西和州，先敗其州兵。

translations.literal: He broke two thousand Song troops at Baxie Valley, took Dangchang County, advanced on Xihe Prefecture, and first defeated its prefectural troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Baxie Valley he broke two thousand Song soldiers, seized Dangchang County, moved on Xihe Prefecture, and first routed its local force.

sentences.zh: 明日，木波兵三千與宋兵合，依川為陣，長壽奮擊，宋兵入保城，堅壁不復出，長壽乃還。

translations.literal: The next day three thousand Mubo troops joined the Song and drew up along the river. Changshou struck hard; the Song withdrew into the city, sealed the walls and would not sally; Changshou then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The next day three thousand Mubo fighters joined the Song and formed along the river. Changshou attacked fiercely; the Song shut themselves in the city and would not come out, and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 凡斬馘八千，獲馬二百余、牛羊三萬，器械軍實甚多。

translations.literal: In all eight thousand heads were cut; more than two hundred horses, thirty thousand cattle and sheep, and vast stores of weapons and military goods were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In all he took eight thousand heads, more than two hundred horses, thirty thousand head of cattle and sheep, and a great haul of arms and supplies.

sentences.zh: 納蘭記僧出洮州鐵城堡，屢敗宋人，完軍而還。

translations.literal: Nalan Jiseng marched out from Tao Prefecture's Tiecheng Fort, repeatedly defeated the Song, and returned with his army intact.
translations.idiomatic: Nalan Jiseng came out from Tiecheng Fort in Tao Prefecture, beat the Song again and again, and brought his army home whole.

sentences.zh: 詔賞鳳翔、秦、鞏伐宋將士，長壽遙授隴安軍節度使，同知通遠軍、提控如故。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded the troops of Fengxiang, Qin, and Gong who had attacked Song; Changshou was remotely appointed military commissioner of the Long'an Army, his posts as vice commissioner of Tongyuan and tiju unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: An edict rewarded the Fengxiang, Qin, and Gong forces that had fought Song; Changshou received by remote appointment the Long'an commissionership, while keeping Tongyuan and his tiju post.

sentences.zh: 頃之，長壽升總領都提控，改通遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Changshou was promoted to chief overall tiju and made military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made chief overall tiju and commissioner of the Tongyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 夏人攻定西，是時弟世顯已降夏人，夏人執世顯至定西城下，謂長壽曰：「若不速降，即殺汝弟。」

translations.literal: Xi Xia attacked Dingxi; at that time his younger brother Shixian had already submitted to Xi Xia, and they brought Shixian before Dingxi's walls, saying to Changshou: 「If you do not surrender quickly, we will kill your brother.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia attacked Dingxi; by then his brother Shixian had gone over to them, and they brought him before the walls, telling Changshou: 「Surrender at once, or we kill your brother.

sentences.zh: 長壽不顧，奮戰。

translations.literal: 」Changshou paid no heed and fought fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: 」Changshou ignored them and fought on.

sentences.zh: 夏兵退，加榮祿大夫，賜金二十五兩、重幣三端。

translations.literal: When the Xia army withdrew he was advanced to Grand Master of Glorious Emolument and given twenty-five taels of gold and three bolts of heavy silks.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xia withdrew he was raised to Grand Master of Glorious Emolument and given twenty-five taels of gold and three bolts of heavy silks.

sentences.zh: 世顯既降，二子公政、重壽當緣坐。

translations.literal: Since Shixian had submitted, his two sons Gongzheng and Zhongshou were liable to collective punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shixian had defected, his sons Gongzheng and Zhongshou were subject to collective punishment.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘉長壽守定西功，釋公政兄弟，有司廩給之。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong emperor commended Changshou for defending Dingxi and released Gongzheng and his brother; the relevant offices supplied them from the state granary.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong praised Changshou for holding Dingxi and freed Gongzheng and his brother; the offices fed them from the public stores.

sentences.zh: 詔長壽曰：「汝久在戎行，盡忠國事。

translations.literal: An edict to Changshou said: 「You have long been in the army and devoted yourself wholly to the state's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Changshou: 「You have spent years in the field and given the state your full loyalty.

sentences.zh: 世顯之降，必不得已，汝永念國恩，益思自效。」

translations.literal: Shixian's surrender was surely unavoidable; hold the state's grace always in mind and think all the more of proving yourself.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian's surrender could not be helped; keep the state's favor ever in mind and strive all the harder to repay it.

sentences.zh: 未幾，夏人複攻會州，行元帥府事石盞合喜發兵救未至，夏人移兵臨洮，長壽伏精兵五千於定西險要間，敗夏兵三萬騎，殺千餘人，獲馬數百。

translations.literal: 」Before long Xi Xia again attacked Huizhou; Shi Zhan Hexi, acting as the field-marshal office, dispatched relief that had not arrived when the Xia shifted to Lintao. Changshou hid five thousand picked troops in Dingxi's defiles, routed thirty thousand Xia horsemen, killed more than a thousand, and took several hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: 」Soon the Xia struck Huizhou again; Shi Zhan Hexi, acting marshal, sent relief that had not come when the enemy turned on Lintao. Changshou ambushed five thousand elite troops in the passes of Dingxi, routed thirty thousand Xia horsemen, killed more than a thousand, and seized several hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 夏人已破西寧，乃犯定西，長壽擊卻之，斬首三百級。

translations.literal: The Xia had already taken Xining and then struck at Dingxi; Changshou drove them back and cut three hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: After taking Xining the Xia moved on Dingxi; Changshou beat them back and took three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 既而三萬騎複至，攻城甚急。

translations.literal: Before long thirty thousand horsemen came again and pressed the siege fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Before long thirty thousand horsemen returned and pressed the city hard.

sentences.zh: 長壽乘城拒戰，矢石如雨，夏兵死者數千，被創者眾，乃解去。

translations.literal: Changshou fought from atop the walls; arrows and stones fell like rain; thousands of Xia soldiers died and many were wounded, and they then lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: Changshou fought from the battlements as arrows and stones fell like rain; thousands of Xia soldiers fell and many more were wounded, and they broke off the siege.

sentences.zh: 是歲卒。

translations.literal: He died that year.
translations.idiomatic: He died that year.

sentences.zh: 完顏佐+完顏齩住

translations.literal: Wanyan Zuo; Wanyan Yaozhu
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Zuo; Wanyan Yaozhu

sentences.zh: 完顏佐，本姓梁氏，初為武清縣巡檢。

translations.literal: Wanyan Zuo, originally surnamed Liang, was at first patrol inspector of Wuqing County.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Zuo, born Liang, first served as patrol inspector of Wuqing County.

sentences.zh: 完顏齩住，本姓李氏，為柳口鎮巡檢。

translations.literal: Wanyan Yaozhu, originally surnamed Li, was patrol inspector of Liukou Town.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Yaozhu, born Li, was patrol inspector of Liukou Town.

sentences.zh: 久之，以佐為都統，齩住副之，戍直沽寨。

translations.literal: After a long while Zuo was made metropolitan commander with Yaozhu as his deputy, garrisoning Zhigu Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In time Zuo was made metropolitan commander with Yaozhu as deputy, stationed at Zhigu Stockade.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，颭軍遣張暉等三人來招佐，佐執之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou rebel troops sent Zhang Hui and two others to recruit Zuo; Zuo seized them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou rebels sent Zhang Hui and two others to win Zuo over; Zuo arrested them.

sentences.zh: 翌日，劉永昌率眾二十人持文書來，署其年曰天賜，佐擲之，麾眾執永昌，及暉等並斬之。

translations.literal: The next day Liu Yongchang led twenty men bearing documents that dated the year as Tianci; Zuo cast them aside, ordered his men to seize Yongchang, and beheaded him together with Hui and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Liu Yongchang came with twenty followers carrying papers dated to the Tianci reign; Zuo threw them down, had his men seize Yongchang, and beheaded him along with Hui and the rest.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘉其功，遷佐奉國上將軍，遙授德州防禦使，齩住鎮國上將軍，遙授同知河間府事，皆賜姓完顏氏。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong emperor commended their merit: Zuo was made Generalissimo of the Nation-Sustaining Army and remotely appointed commissioner of Dezhou defense; Yaozhu was made Generalissimo of the Nation-Pacifying Army and remotely appointed vice prefect of Hejian—all were granted the surname Wanyan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong rewarded them: Zuo became Generalissimo of the Nation-Sustaining Army and remote defense commissioner of Dezhou; Yaozhu became Generalissimo of the Nation-Pacifying Army and remote vice prefect of Hejian—and both received the surname Wanyan.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「自今有忠義如是者，並一體遷授。」

translations.literal: The edict said: 「From now on, whoever shows loyalty and righteousness such as this shall alike be promoted in one measure.」
translations.idiomatic: The edict read: 「Hereafter, all who show such loyalty and righteousness shall be advanced together in the same way.」

sentences.zh: 贊曰：古者天子胙土命氏，漢以來乃有賜姓。

translations.literal: The encomium states: In antiquity the Son of Heaven enfeoffed land and bestowed clan names; since Han times there has been the granting of surnames.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: In old times the Son of Heaven granted fiefs and bestowed clan names; only since Han have surnames been given as reward.

sentences.zh: 宣宗假以賞一時之功，郭仲元、郭阿鄰以功皆賜國姓。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong emperor borrowed it to reward merit of the moment; Guo Zhongyuan and Guo Alin were both granted the imperial surname for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong used the practice to reward passing merit; Guo Zhongyuan and Guo Alin both received the imperial surname for their deeds.

sentences.zh: 女奚烈資祿、烏古論長壽皆封疆之臣而賜以他姓。

translations.literal: Nüxilie Zilu and Wugulun Changshou were both frontier ministers yet granted other surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Nüxilie Zilu and Wugulun Changshou were border lords of long service, yet each was given a different surname.

sentences.zh: 貞祐以後，賜姓有格。

translations.literal: After Zhenyou, granting surnames had regulations.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhenyou the grant of surnames followed fixed rules.

sentences.zh: 夫以名使人，用之貴則貴，用之賤則賤，使人計功而得國姓，則以其貴者反賤矣。

translations.literal: To use a name to move people—the noble becomes noble when so used, base when so used base; if men receive the imperial surname by tallying merit, what was noble in it is turned base.
translations.idiomatic: A name moves men only as the ruler uses it—made noble it is noble, made cheap it is cheap; when men win the imperial surname by counting merit alone, what was noble becomes cheap.

sentences.zh: 完顏霆、完顏佐皆賜國姓者，並附於此。

translations.literal: Wanyan Ting and Wanyan Zuo, both granted the imperial surname, are appended here.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Ting and Wanyan Zuo, who received the imperial surname, are recorded here together.

sentences.zh: 石抹仲溫

translations.literal: Shimo Zhongwen
translations.idiomatic: Shimo Zhongwen

sentences.zh: 石抹仲溫，本名老斡，懿州胡土虎猛安人。

translations.literal: Shimo Zhongwen, original name Laogan, was a native of the Hutuhu garrison-colony of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shimo Zhongwen, born Laogan, came from the Hutuhu colony at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 充護衛十人長、太子僕正，除同知武甯軍節度使事、宿直將軍、器物局使。

translations.literal: He served as captain of ten guardsmen and director of the crown prince's stable, then was appointed vice commissioner of the Wuning Army, palace attendant general, and director of the Implements Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was captain of ten guardsmen and master of the crown prince's stables, then made vice commissioner of the Wuning Army, palace attendant general, and director of the Implements Bureau.

sentences.zh: 坐前在武寧造馬鞍虧直，章宗原之，改左衛將軍，遷左副點檢。

translations.literal: For having once at Wuning made saddles at a loss when pricing them, Zhangzong pardoned him and made him general of the Left Guard, then transferred him to left deputy surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had once undervalued saddle work at Wuning, Zhangzong pardoned him, made him general of the Left Guard, and later moved him to left deputy surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 坐征契丹逗遛，降蔡州防禦使。

translations.literal: For dawdling on the Khitan campaign, he was demoted to commissioner of Caizhou defense.
translations.idiomatic: For dragging his feet on the Khitan campaign he was demoted to defense commissioner of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 複召為左副點檢，遷知臨洮府事。

translations.literal: He was recalled as left deputy surveillance commissioner and made prefect of Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as left deputy surveillance commissioner and appointed prefect of Lintao.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，青宜可內附，進爵二級，賜銀二百五十兩、重幣十端。

translations.literal: During the Taihe campaign against Song, Qingyi Ke came over to the side of Jin; he advanced two noble ranks and was given two hundred fifty taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe war on Song, when Qingyi Ke submitted, he rose two noble ranks and received two hundred fifty taels of silver and ten bolts of heavy silks.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「青宜可之來，乃汝管內，與有勞焉。

translations.literal: The edict said: 「Qingyi Ke's coming is within your jurisdiction, and you share in the labor of it.
translations.idiomatic: The edict read: 「Qingyi Ke came in under your command, and you share the credit.

sentences.zh: 比與青宜可相合，其間諸事量宜而行。」

translations.literal: Work in concert with Qingyi Ke now; on all matters between you act as circumstances require.
translations.idiomatic: Work closely with him now; handle everything between you as the situation demands.

sentences.zh: 頃之，諸道進兵，仲溫以隴右步騎五千出鹽川。

translations.literal: 」Before long armies advanced on every circuit; Zhongwen led five thousand infantry and cavalry of Longyou out through Yanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: 」Before long columns moved on every front; Zhongwen took five thousand Longyou foot and horse out by Yanchuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，罷兵，改知河中府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year hostilities ceased; he was made prefect of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the war ended; he became prefect of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 崇慶初，遷陝西統軍使。

translations.literal: At the start of Chongqing he was made army commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Chongqing he was made army commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，宋人攻秦州，促溫率兵敗之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou the Song attacked Qinzhou; Zhongwen led troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou the Song struck Qinzhou; Zhongwen took the field and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 尋充本路安撫使，改鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: Soon he became pacification commissioner of this circuit and was made military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was pacification commissioner of the circuit and commissioner of the Zhennan Army.

sentences.zh: 致仕。

translations.literal: He retired.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xingding he died.

sentences.zh: 烏古論禮

translations.literal: Wugulun Li
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Li

sentences.zh: 烏古論禮，本名六斤，益都猛安人。

translations.literal: Wugulun Li, original name Liujin, was a native of the Yidu garrison-colony.
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Li, born Liujin, came from the Yidu colony.

sentences.zh: 充習騎，累擢近侍局直長，轉本局副使、左衛副將軍。

translations.literal: He served in riding practice, was repeatedly promoted to chief steward of the Inner Service Bureau, then became its deputy director and deputy general of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Trained in the riding school, he rose through the Inner Service Bureau to chief steward, then deputy director and deputy general of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 坐受沁南軍節度使兗王永成名馬玉帶，杖一百，削官解職。

translations.literal: For accepting famous horses and jade belts from Yan Prince Yongcheng, military commissioner of the Qinnan Army, he was beaten one hundred strokes, stripped of office, and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: For taking fine horses and jade belts from Prince Yongcheng of Yan, commissioner of the Qinnan Army, he was flogged a hundred strokes, stripped of rank, and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 起為蒲速碗群牧副使，改武庫署令、宿直將軍，複為左衛副將軍、順州刺史，累遷武寧軍節度。

translations.literal: He was reappointed deputy herds commissioner of Pusawan, made director of the Armory Office and palace attendant general, again left deputy general and prefect of Shunzhou, and eventually military commissioner of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: He returned as deputy herds commissioner of Pusawan, then director of the Armory, palace attendant general, again deputy general of the Left Guard and prefect of Shunzhou, and finally commissioner of the Wuning Army.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，為山東路兵馬都統副使兼副統軍、安化軍節度。

translations.literal: During Taihe he was deputy overall commander of Shandong Route forces, also deputy army commissioner, and commissioner of the Anhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe campaign he was deputy overall commander on the Shandong Route, also deputy army commissioner and commissioner of the Anhua Army.

sentences.zh: 八年，宋人請盟，罷兵馬都統官，仍以節度兼副統軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Song sought peace; the overall commander post was abolished, but he still combined commissioner with deputy army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Song sued for peace; the overall commander post was abolished, but he kept the commissionership with the deputy army command.

sentences.zh: 大安三年，改知歸德府兼河南副統軍，曆知河南府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Da'an he was made prefect of Guide and deputy army commissioner of Henan South, and successively prefect of Henan South.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Da'an he governed Guide while also deputy army commissioner of Henan South, and later held the Henan South prefecture in turn.

sentences.zh: 至甯初，改知太原府事。

translations.literal: At the start of Zhibing he was made prefect of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Zhibing he became prefect of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，兼河東北路安撫使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he also served as pacification commissioner of the Hedong North Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he also served as pacification commissioner of the Hedong North Route.

sentences.zh: 三年，充本路宣撫使，頃之，兼左副元帥。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made pacification commissioner of this route; shortly thereafter he also served as left deputy field marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was pacification commissioner of the route; soon after he also became left deputy field marshal.

sentences.zh: 四年，太原被圍，未幾圍解，進官二階。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Taiyuan was besieged; before long the siege lifted and he advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Taiyuan was besieged; the siege was soon raised and he advanced two ranks.

sentences.zh: 興定三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xingding he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xingding he died.

sentences.zh: 蒲察阿里

translations.literal: Pucha Ali
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Ali

sentences.zh: 奧屯襄

translations.literal: Aotun Xiang
translations.idiomatic: Aotun Xiang

sentences.zh: 奧屯襄，本名添壽，上京路人。

translations.literal: Aotun Xiang, original name Tianshou, was a native of the Upper Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Aotun Xiang, born Tianshou, came from the Upper Capital region.

sentences.zh: 大定十年，襲猛安。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Dading he inherited the garrison-colony command.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Dading he inherited the colony command.

sentences.zh: 丞相襄舉通練邊事，授崇義軍節度副使，改烏古里颭詳穩，召為都水少監、石州刺史。

translations.literal: Chancellor Xiang recommended him as thoroughly versed in frontier affairs; he was appointed deputy commissioner of the Chongyi Army, made Zhain-wen of Wuguli, recalled as vice director of waterways and prefect of Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Xiang praised his mastery of border affairs; he became deputy commissioner of the Chongyi Army, then Zhain-wen of Wuguli, and was recalled as vice director of waterways and prefect of Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，為平南蕩江將軍，以功升壽州防禦使，遷河南路副統軍兼同知歸德府事、昌武軍節度使，仍兼副統軍。

translations.literal: Before long he became the Pingnan Dangjiang General; for merit he was promoted commissioner of Shouzhou defense, transferred to deputy army commissioner of the Henan Route while also vice prefect of Guide and commissioner of the Changwu Army, still holding deputy army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made the Pingnan Dangjiang General; for merit he rose to defense commissioner of Shouzhou, then deputy army commissioner on the Henan Route with concurrent vice prefecture of Guide and the Changwu commissionership, while keeping the deputy army post.

sentences.zh: 崇慶改元，為元帥左都監，救西京，至墨穀口，一軍盡殪，襄僅以身免，坐是除名。

translations.literal: When Chongqing adopted a new reign title he became left overseer of the field marshals; to relieve the Western Capital he reached Mogukou—a whole army was wiped out, Xiang barely escaped with his life, and for this was struck from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: At the Chongqing reign change he became left overseer of the field marshals; marching to save the Western Capital he reached Mogukou, where an entire army was destroyed and Xiang barely escaped—he was struck from the rolls for it.

sentences.zh: 明年，授上京兵馬使。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed military commissioner of the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed military commissioner of the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，擢遼東路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: When the Xuanzong emperor took the throne he was raised to deputy pacification commissioner of the Liaodong Route.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong came to the throne he was made deputy pacification commissioner of the Liaodong Route.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改速頻路節度使，兼同知上京留守事。

translations.literal: Before long he was made military commissioner of the Supin Route and concurrently vice administrative commissioner of the Upper Capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was commissioner of the Supin Route and also vice commissioner of the Upper Capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，為元帥右都監，行元帥府事于北京。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, he became right overseer of the field marshals and conducted field-marshal affairs at the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, he became right overseer of the field marshals and ran the marshal's office at the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 五月，改留守，兼前職，俄遷宣撫使兼留守。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was made garrison commissioner while retaining his prior posts; soon he was transferred to pacification commissioner while also garrison commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was made garrison commissioner while keeping his other posts; soon he was pacification commissioner as well.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔諭襄及遼東路宣撫使蒲鮮萬奴、宣差蒲察五斤曰：「上京、遼東，國家重地，以卿等累效忠勤，故委腹心，意其協力盡公，以徇國家之急。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict instructed Xiang, Liaodong Route pacification commissioner Puxian Wannu, and special commissioner Pucha Wujin, saying: 「The Upper Capital and Liaodong are weighty places of the state; because you have repeatedly shown loyal diligence we entrust you with our inner hearts, expecting you to work in concert and exhaust the public good to answer the state's emergency.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict addressed Xiang, Liaodong pacification commissioner Puxian Wannu, and special commissioner Pucha Wujin: 「The Upper Capital and Liaodong are the state's vital ground; you have long served with loyal diligence, and we place our trust in you, expecting you to act as one and give all for the state's urgent need.

sentences.zh: 及詳來奏，乃大不然，朕將何賴。

translations.literal: Yet when I examine your memorials in detail, they are greatly otherwise—upon whom shall I rely?
translations.idiomatic: Yet your detailed reports show something quite different—whom can we rely on now?

sentences.zh: 自今每事同心，並力備禦，機會一失，悔之何及！

translations.literal: From now on be of one mind in every affair and unite your strength in defense; once opportunity is lost, what regret will avail!
translations.idiomatic: From now on be united in every matter and combine your strength in defense; once the moment is lost, regret will come too late!

sentences.zh: 且師克在和，善鈞從眾，尚懲前過，以圖後功。」

translations.literal: An army conquers through harmony; weigh well and follow the multitude; still chastise your past errors to seek future merit.
translations.idiomatic: Armies win through harmony; weigh the common will and follow it; learn from your past faults and strive for merit hereafter.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，襄為北京宣差提控完顏習烈所害。

translations.literal: 」In the first month of the third year Xiang was killed by Wanyan Xilie, the special tiju of the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: 」In the first month of the third year Xiang was killed by Wanyan Xilie, special tiju of the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 未幾，習烈複為其下所殺，詔曲赦北京。

translations.literal: Before long, Xilie was again killed by his subordinates; an edict granted a partial amnesty for the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, Xilie was killed again by his own men, and the court issued a limited amnesty for the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 完顏蒲剌都

translations.literal: Wanyan Puladu
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Puladu

sentences.zh: 完顏蒲剌都，西南路按出灰必剌罕猛安人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Puladu was a native of the Aichuhui Bibila Khan colony on the Southwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Puladu came from the Aichuhui Bibila Khan colony in the Southwest Route.

sentences.zh: 充護衛，除泰定軍節度副使。

translations.literal: He served as a guardsman and was appointed deputy military commissioner of the Taiding Army.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the guards and was made deputy commissioner of the Taiding Army.

sentences.zh: 以憂去官，起複唐古部族節度副使，徙安國軍，移颭詳穩，累官原州刺史。

translations.literal: He left office on account of mourning, was restored as deputy military commissioner of the Tangut Tribes, was transferred to the Anguo Army, became tribal commander of Feng, and rose through offices to prefect of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned for mourning, returned as deputy commissioner of the Tangut Tribes, moved to the Anguo Army, became a Feng tribal commander, and eventually reached prefect of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 坐買部內馬虧直，奪官一階，降北京兵馬都指揮使、甯遠軍刺史，曆同知臨洮府、西京留守事。

translations.literal: For buying horses within his jurisdiction at a loss he was stripped one rank, demoted to commander-in-chief of Northern Capital troops and cishi of Ningyuan Army, and served as deputy prefect of Lintao and acting Western Capital garrison commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After buying horses in his district at a loss, he lost one rank and was demoted to Northern Capital troop commander and Ningyuan Army prefect; he later served as deputy Lintao prefect and acting Western Capital garrison commissioner.

sentences.zh: 崇慶元年，遷震武軍節度，備禦有功，遷一官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongqing he was transferred to Zhenwu Army military commissioner; for meritorious defense he was advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongqing he became commissioner of the Zhenwu Army; for successful border defense he was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，置東西面經略司，就充西面經略使，上言：「管內大和嶺諸隘屯兵，控制邊要。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou the Eastern and Western Frontier Commissariats were established; he was appointed Western Frontier Commissioner and submitted a memorial: 「Within my jurisdiction garrison troops at the passes of Dahe Ridge control strategic border points.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou the Eastern and Western frontier offices were set up; he was made Western Frontier Commissioner and wrote: 「Garrisons at the passes along Dahe Ridge in my district hold the key border positions.

sentences.zh: 行元帥府輒分臣兵萬二千戍真定，餘眾不足守禦，近日複簡精銳二千七百人以往。

translations.literal: The itinerant marshal's headquarters has repeatedly detached twelve thousand of my troops to garrison Zhending; the remainder is insufficient for defense, and recently another two thousand seven hundred picked men were drafted and sent thither.
translations.idiomatic: The itinerant marshal's office keeps taking twelve thousand of my men for Zhending; what is left cannot hold the line, and lately another twenty-seven hundred picked troops were sent away.

sentences.zh: 今見兵不滿萬，老羸者十七八。

translations.literal: My present force is fewer than ten thousand, of whom seventeen or eighteen in ten are aged or infirm.
translations.idiomatic: I now have fewer than ten thousand men, and seven or eight in ten are old or weak.

sentences.zh: 臣死固不足惜，顧國家之事不可不慮，新設經略移文西京、太原、河東取軍馬，大數並稱非臣所統。」

translations.literal: My death is truly of little account, yet the affairs of the state cannot go unconsidered; the newly established frontier commissariat has sent documents to the Western Capital, Taiyuan, and Hedong to draw troops, and in every case they claim they are not under my command.
translations.idiomatic: My own death would not matter, but the state cannot be left unguarded; the new frontier office has requisitioned troops from the Western Capital, Taiyuan, and Hedong, yet they all say they are outside my command.

sentences.zh: 詔真定元帥府還其精銳二千七百人。

translations.literal: 」An edict ordered the Zhending marshal's headquarters to return his two thousand seven hundred picked troops.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court ordered the Zhending marshal's office to return the twenty-seven hundred picked troops.

sentences.zh: 西京、太原、嵐州有警急，約為應援。

translations.literal: When the Western Capital, Taiyuan, or Lanzhou faced urgent alarms, they were to coordinate mutual reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: If the Western Capital, Taiyuan, or Lanzhou came under sudden attack, they were to reinforce one another by agreement.

sentences.zh: 州郡皆不欲屬經略司，遂罷經略官，入為簽樞密院事，改左副點檢。

translations.literal: The prefectures and districts all wished not to fall under the frontier commissariat; the frontier posts were therefore abolished, he entered the Bureau of Military Affairs as a signing participant, and was changed to left vice director of inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures refused to answer to the frontier office, so the frontier commissioners were abolished; he entered the Bureau of Military Affairs as a signing member and became left vice director of inspection.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷兵部尚書，興定元年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Minister of War; in the first year of Xingding he retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became Minister of War; in the first year of Xingding he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died.

sentences.zh: 夾谷石里哥

translations.literal: Jiagu Shilige
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu Shilige

sentences.zh: 朮甲臣嘉

translations.literal: Shujia Chenjia
translations.idiomatic: Shujia Chenjia

sentences.zh: 朮甲臣嘉，北京路猛安人，襲父謀克。

translations.literal: Shujia Chenjia was a native of the Beijing Route colony; he inherited his father's company command.
translations.idiomatic: Shujia Chenjia came from a Beijing Route colony and inherited his father's company command.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，隸陝西完顏綱麾下。

translations.literal: In the Taihe campaign against Song he served under Wanyan Gang in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taihe war against Song he served under Wanyan Gang in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 曆通州、海州同知軍州事。

translations.literal: He served successively as deputy prefect of Tongzhou and Haizhou military prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He served as deputy prefect of Tongzhou and Haizhou in turn.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，除武器署丞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was appointed vice-director of the Weapons Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he was made vice-director of the Weapons Bureau.

sentences.zh: 救集甯有功，遷河南統軍判官、拱衛直副都指揮使、河南治中，遙領綏州刺史兼延安治中，就遷同知府事，改同知河間府事。

translations.literal: For merit in relieving Jining he was promoted to judge of Henan Circuit Command, deputy commander of the Arch Halberd Direct Garrison, Henan administrator, concurrently prefect of Suizhou and Yan'an administrator, then promoted to deputy prefect, then deputy prefect of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: For saving Jining he was promoted to Henan circuit judge, deputy commander of the Arch Halberd Direct Garrison, Henan administrator, and concurrently prefect of Suizhou and Yan'an administrator; he then became deputy prefect and later deputy prefect of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，行樞密院于壽州，由壽、泗渡淮伐宋。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding the itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs was at Shouzhou; he crossed the Huai from Shou and Si to attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding the itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs operated from Shouzhou; he crossed the Huai from Shou and Si to strike Song.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，破宋兵三千於漸湖灘，斬三百級。

translations.literal: In the second year, second month, he defeated three thousand Song troops at Jianhu Beach and took three hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, second month, he routed three thousand Song troops at Jianhu Beach and beheaded three hundred.

sentences.zh: 有詔蹂踐宋境上，毋深入。

translations.literal: An edict ordered ravaging Song territory at the border without deep penetration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told them to harry Song borderlands but not push deep inland.

sentences.zh: 臣嘉駐霍丘楂岡村，縱輕騎鈔掠，焚毀積聚。

translations.literal: Chenjia encamped at Zhagang village in Huoqiu, sent light cavalry to raid, and burned stores.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjia camped at Zhagang in Huoqiu, sent light horsemen to raid, and burned stockpiles.

sentences.zh: 獲宋諜者張聰，知宋兵二千屯高柳橋，老幼甚眾，其寨兩城，環之以水。

translations.literal: Capturing the Song spy Zhang Cong, he learned two thousand Song troops were at Gaoliu Bridge with many old and young; their stockade had two walled enclosures ringed by water.
translations.idiomatic: From the captured Song spy Zhang Cong he learned that two thousand Song troops held Gaoliu Bridge with many families; their camp had twin walled enclosures surrounded by water.

sentences.zh: 臣嘉遣張聰持牒招之，不從。

translations.literal: Chenjia sent Zhang Cong with a summons to recruit them; they did not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjia sent Zhang Cong with a summons to win them over; they refused.

sentences.zh: 先令水軍徑渡攻之。

translations.literal: He first ordered the naval force to cross directly and attack.
translations.idiomatic: He first sent the naval force straight across to attack.

sentences.zh: 軍士牛青操戈刺門卒，皆披靡散去，遂登陴，大軍繼之，夷其寨而還。

translations.literal: The soldier Niu Qing wielded a spear and stabbed the gate guards; all scattered in rout; they then scaled the ramparts, the main army followed, levelled the stockade, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The soldier Niu Qing spear-thrust the gate guards and they scattered; his men climbed the walls, the main force followed, destroyed the camp, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遇宋兵數千于梅景村。

translations.literal: They encountered several thousand Song troops at Meijing village.
translations.idiomatic: They met several thousand Song troops at Meijing village.

sentences.zh: 臣嘉伏兵林間，以步卒誘致之，伏發，宋兵潰，追奔十餘里，生擒其將阮世安等五人，獲器仗甚眾。

translations.literal: Chenjia hid troops in the woods, used infantry to lure them in, sprang the ambush, the Song army routed; pursuing more than ten li they captured alive their general Ruan Shi'an and four others, and seized abundant arms.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjia hid men in the forest, baited them with foot soldiers, then struck from ambush; the Song force broke and fled; after a pursuit of more than ten li they took General Ruan Shi'an and four others alive and captured a great quantity of weapons.

sentences.zh: 七月，賞征南功，升職一等，遷元帥右都監，充陝西行省參議官。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, for southern campaign merit his rank rose one grade; he was made right overseer of field marshals and Shaanxi Branch Secretariat councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was rewarded for the southern campaign with a one-grade promotion, made right overseer of field marshals, and Shaanxi Branch Secretariat councillor.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼金安軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he also held Jin'an Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he also served as commissioner of Jin'an Army.

sentences.zh: 五年，改知延安府事，轉左都監，駐兵京兆。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was changed to administrator of Yan'an prefecture, transferred to left overseer, and garrisoned troops at Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became administrator of Yan'an, was made left overseer, and stationed troops at Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 元光元年，卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanguang he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanguang he died.

sentences.zh: 紇石烈桓端

translations.literal: Heseli Huanduan
translations.idiomatic: Heseli Huanduan

sentences.zh: 紇石烈桓端，西南路忽論宋割猛安人，襲兄銀朮可謀可。
