translations.literal: Heseli Huanduan was a native of the Hulun Songge colony of the Southwest Route; he inherited his elder brother's company command of Yintuoke Mouke.
translations.idiomatic: Heseli Huanduan came from the Hulun Songge colony on the Southwest Route and inherited his elder brother's Yintuoke company command.

sentences.zh: 泰和伐宋，充行軍萬戶，破宋兵二千于蔡州，加宣武將軍。

translations.literal: In the Taihe campaign against Song he served as campaign ten-thousand-household; he defeated two thousand Song troops at Caizhou and was promoted to General of Manifest Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe war against Song he served as campaign ten-thousand-household, defeated two thousand Song troops at Caizhou, and was made General of Manifest Martiality.

sentences.zh: 自壽州渡淮，敗宋步騎一萬五千於鷂子嶺，遂克安豐軍。

translations.literal: Crossing the Huai from Shouzhou he defeated fifteen thousand Song infantry and cavalry at Yaozi Ridge and then captured Anfeng Army.
translations.idiomatic: From Shouzhou he crossed the Huai, routed fifteen thousand Song foot and horse at Yaozi Ridge, and took Anfeng Army.

sentences.zh: 軍還，除同知懷遠軍節度事，權木典颭詳穩。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was made deputy military commissioner of Huaiyuan Army while acting as tribal commander of Mudian Feng.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he became deputy commissioner of Huaiyuan Army and acting Feng tribal commander at Mudian.

sentences.zh: 大安三年，西京行省選充合紮萬戶，遙授同知清州防禦事，改興平軍節度副使，遙授顯德軍節度副使，徙遼東路宣撫司都統。

translations.literal: In the third year of Da'an the Western Capital Branch Secretariat selected him as combined encampment ten-thousand-household, appointed in absentia deputy defender of Qingzhou, changed to deputy military commissioner of Xingping Army, appointed in absentia deputy military commissioner of Xiande Army, transferred to commander-in-chief of Liaodong Route Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Da'an the Western Capital Branch Secretariat made him combined encampment ten-thousand-household, deputy defender of Qingzhou in absentia, deputy commissioner of Xingping Army, deputy commissioner of Xiande Army in absentia, and then commander-in-chief of the Liaodong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 敗移剌留哥萬五千眾於禦河寨，奪車數千兩，降萬餘人。

translations.literal: He defeated Yelü Liuge's fifteen thousand at Yuhe Stockade, seized several thousand carts, and caused more than ten thousand to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated fifteen thousand of Yelü Liuge's men at Yuhe Stockade, captured thousands of carts, and accepted the surrender of more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 加驃騎衛上將軍，遙授同知順天軍節度事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Senior General of the Flying-Cavalry Guard and appointed in absentia deputy military commissioner of Shuntian Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Senior General of the Flying-Cavalry Guard and deputy commissioner of Shuntian Army in absentia.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，為宣差副提控，同知婆速路兵馬都總管，行府事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he became vice special tiju, deputy commander-in-chief of Bosu Route troops, and conducted prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he became vice special tiju, deputy commander-in-chief of Bosu Route forces, and ran prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 貞祐三年，蒲鮮萬奴取咸平、東京沈、澄諸州，及猛安謀克人亦多從之者。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyou Puxian Wannu took Xiaping, Dongjing Shen, Cheng and other prefectures, and many colony commanders and company officers also followed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenyou Puxian Wannu seized Xiaping, Dongjing Shen, Cheng, and other prefectures, and many colony and company officers went over to him as well.

sentences.zh: 三月，萬奴步騎九千侵婆速近境，桓端遣都統溫蒂罕怕哥輦擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the third month Wannu's infantry and cavalry nine thousand invaded the Bosu borderlands; Huanduan sent commander Wentihen Pagehanian to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Wannu led nine thousand foot and horse against the Bosu frontier; Huanduan sent Commander Wentihen Pagehanian to drive them back.

sentences.zh: 四月，複掠上京城，遣都統兀顏缽轄拒戰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month they again raided Shangjing; he sent commander Wanyan Boxia to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month they raided Shangjing again; he sent Commander Wanyan Boxia to meet them.

sentences.zh: 萬奴別遣五千人攻望雲驛，都統奧屯馬和尚擊之。

translations.literal: Wannu separately sent five thousand men to attack Wangyun Post; commander Aotun Maheshang attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: Wannu also sent five thousand men against Wangyun Post; Commander Aotun Maheshang struck them.

sentences.zh: 都統夾穀合打破其眾數千於三叉里。

translations.literal: Commander Jiagu Heji defeated several thousand of their force at Sanchali.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Jiagu Heji routed several thousand of the enemy at Sanchali.

sentences.zh: 五月，都統溫蒂罕福壽攻萬奴之眾於大寧鎮，拔其壘，其眾殲焉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month commander Wentihen Fushou attacked Wannu's force at Daning town, stormed their ramparts, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Commander Wentihen Fushou attacked Wannu's troops at Daning town, took their fort, and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 九月，萬奴眾九千人出宜風及湯池，桓端率兵與戰，其眾潰去，因招奄吉斡、都麻渾、賓哥、出臺、答愛、顏哥、不灰、活拙、按出、孛德、烈鄰十一猛安複來附，擇其丁男補軍，攻城邑之未下者。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wannu's force nine thousand came out through Yifeng and Tangchi; Huanduan led troops to fight them and they routed and fled; he thereby recruited eleven colonies—Yanjiwo, Doumahun, Binge, Chutai, Da'ai, Yange, Buhui, Huozhuo, Aichu, Bode, Lieyin—to submit again, selected their able-bodied men to fill the army, and attacked cities not yet taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month nine thousand of Wannu's men came through Yifeng and Tangchi; Huanduan gave battle and they broke and fled; he then won back eleven colonies—Yanjiwo, Doumahun, Binge, Chutai, Da'ai, Yange, Buhui, Huozhuo, Aichu, Bode, and Lieyin—drafted their able men into the army, and pressed the siege of towns still holding out.

sentences.zh: 貞祐四年，桓端遣王汝弼由海道奏事，宣宗嘉其功，桓端遷遼海軍節度使、同知行府事，宣差提控如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyou Huanduan sent Wang Rubi by sea route to memorialize the throne; Emperor Xuanzong praised his merit; Huanduan was transferred to Liaohai Army military commissioner and deputy conductor of prefectural affairs, his special tiju unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenyou Huanduan sent Wang Rubi by sea to report to the throne; Emperor Xuanzong commended his service; Huanduan was made commissioner of Liaohai Army and deputy conductor of prefectural affairs while keeping his special tiju post.

sentences.zh: 婆速路溫甲海世襲猛安、權同知府事溫蒂罕哥不靄遷顯德軍節度使，兼婆速府治中。

translations.literal: The hereditary colony commander of Wenjiahai on Bosu Route and acting deputy prefect Wentihen Kebu'ai was transferred to Xiande Army military commissioner while also Bosu prefect administrator.
translations.idiomatic: The hereditary Wenjiahai colony commander and acting deputy prefect Wentihen Kebu'ai was made commissioner of Xiande Army and administrator of Bosu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 權判官、前修起居注裴滿按帶遷兩階，升二等。

translations.literal: Acting judge and former annotator of the Imperial Diary Peiman An'dai was advanced two ranks and promoted two grades.
translations.idiomatic: Acting judge and former Imperial Diary annotator Peiman An'dai was promoted two ranks and two grades.

sentences.zh: 王汝弼遷四階，升四等。

translations.literal: Wang Rubi was advanced four ranks and promoted four grades.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rubi was promoted four ranks and four grades.

sentences.zh: 余將士有功者，詔遼東宣撫承制遷賞。

translations.literal: For the remaining officers and soldiers with merit, an edict ordered the Liaodong pacification commissioner to grant promotions by provisional authority.
translations.idiomatic: As for the other officers and soldiers with merit, the court authorized the Liaodong pacification commissioner to reward them by provisional appointment.

sentences.zh: 是歲，改邳州刺史，充徐州界都提控。

translations.literal: That year he was changed to prefect of Pi, and made frontier tiju of the Xuzhou border.
translations.idiomatic: That year he became prefect of Pi and frontier tiju on the Xuzhou border.

sentences.zh: 紅祆賊數萬攻邳州，桓端破之于黃山。

translations.literal: Tens of thousands of Red Turban rebels attacked Pizhou; Huanduan defeated them at Huangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of Red Turban rebels attacked Pizhou; Huanduan defeated them at Huangshan.

sentences.zh: 賊複來，桓端薄其營，走保北山，追擊敗之，溺沂水死者甚眾。

translations.literal: The rebels came again; Huanduan pressed close to their camp; they fled to hold Beishan; pursuing he defeated them, and very many drowned in the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels returned; Huanduan pressed their camp; they fled to Beishan; in pursuit he routed them, and a great many drowned in the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 賊數萬圍沂州，同知防禦事僕散撒合突圍出求救，桓端率兵赴之。

translations.literal: Tens of thousands of rebels besieged Yizhou; deputy defender Pusan Sahe broke out to seek rescue; Huanduan led troops to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of rebels besieged Yizhou; Deputy Defender Pusan Sahe broke out to call for help, and Huanduan marched to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 撒合還入沂州，與桓端內外夾擊之，殺萬餘人，賊乃去。

translations.literal: Sahe returned into Yizhou and with Huanduan struck from within and without, killing more than ten thousand; the rebels then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sahe re-entered Yizhou and, with Huanduan attacking from inside and out, killed more than ten thousand; the rebels then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使僕散安貞上其功，因奏曰：「桓端天資忠實，深有計畫，曉習軍事，撒合勇而有謀，皆得軍民心，乞加擢用。」

translations.literal: Vice Military Affairs Commissioner Pusan Anzhen reported his merit and submitted: 「Huanduan is loyal and steadfast by nature, deeply skilled in planning, versed in military affairs; Sahe is brave and resourceful—both have won the hearts of army and people; I beg they be promoted and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Military Affairs Commissioner Pusan Anzhen reported his achievements and said: 「Huanduan is loyal by nature, far-sighted in counsel, and expert in war; Sahe is bold and shrewd—both hold the trust of troops and people; I ask that they be promoted and put to use.

sentences.zh: 桓端進金紫光祿大夫，兼同知武寧軍節度事，提控如故。

translations.literal: 」Huanduan was promoted to Grand Master of the Gold-purple-girdled rank and made deputy military commissioner of Wuning Army, his tiju unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: 」Huanduan was raised to Grand Master of the Gold-purple-girdled rank and made deputy commissioner of Wuning Army while retaining his tiju post.

sentences.zh: 召為勸農副使，充都提控，屯陳州。

translations.literal: He was summoned as vice commissioner for encouraging agriculture, made supreme tiju, and garrisoned Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as vice commissioner for encouraging agriculture, made supreme tiju, and stationed at Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 徐州行樞密院石盞女魯歡剛愎自用，詔桓端以本官權簽樞密院事，往代之。

translations.literal: Shizhannüluan of the Xuzhou itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs was stubborn and self-willed; an edict ordered Huanduan, retaining his original office, to act as signing participant in the Bureau of Military Affairs and go replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhannüluan at the Xuzhou itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs was obstinate and arbitrary; the court ordered Huanduan, keeping his present title, to serve as acting signing member of the Bureau of Military Affairs and replace him.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，上言：「竊聞宋人與李全將並力來攻，當預為之防。」

translations.literal: In the fourth winter he submitted: 「I hear the Song people and General Li Quan will join forces to attack; we ought to prepare defenses in advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth winter he wrote: 「I hear the Song and General Li Quan mean to attack together; we should prepare defenses beforehand.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏可，召桓端與朝臣面議。

translations.literal: 」The Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized approval and summoned Huanduan to confer face to face with court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: 」The Bureau of Military Affairs approved and summoned Huanduan to discuss the matter with the ministers in person.

sentences.zh: 尋有疾，賜太醫禦藥。

translations.literal: Soon he fell ill and was granted imperial medical drugs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he fell ill and was given imperial medicines.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，召至京師，疾病不能入見，力疾草奏，大略以南北皆用兵，當豫防其患，及防河數策。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year he was summoned to the capital; illness prevented audience; straining against illness he drafted a memorial, in gist that north and south were both at war and ills ought to be forearmed, together with several policies for river defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year he was called to the capital but was too ill to appear; forcing himself, he drafted a memorial arguing that with war on both northern and southern fronts the court must guard against disaster, together with several plans for river defense.

sentences.zh: 無何，卒，年四十五。

translations.literal: Before long he died, aged forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died, at the age of forty-five.

sentences.zh: 敕有司給喪事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to provide funeral arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the proper offices to handle his funeral.

sentences.zh: 完顏阿里不孫

translations.literal: Wanyan Alibusun
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Alibusun

sentences.zh: 完顏阿里不孫，字彥成，曷懶路泰申必剌猛安人。

translations.literal: Wanyan Alibusun, courtesy name Yancheng, was a native of the Taishenbila colony on the Yilao Route.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Alibusun, courtesy name Yancheng, came from the Taishenbila colony on the Yilao Route.

sentences.zh: 明昌五年進士，調易州、忻州軍事判官、安豐縣令。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fifth year of Mingchang; appointed military judge of Yizhou and Xinzhou and magistrate of Anfeng county.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Mingchang and was posted as military judge of Yizhou and Xinzhou and magistrate of Anfeng county.

sentences.zh: 補尚書省令史，除興平軍節度副使，應奉翰林文字，轉修撰，充元帥左監軍紇石烈執中經歷官。

translations.literal: He entered the Secretariat as a clerk, was made deputy military commissioner of Xingping Army, Hanlin drafting attendant, transferred to reviser, and served as staff officer to left marshal supervisor Heseli Zhizhong.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Secretariat as a clerk, became deputy commissioner of Xingping Army, served as Hanlin drafting attendant and reviser, and was staff officer to Left Marshal Supervisor Heseli Zhizhong.

sentences.zh: 執中圍楚州，縱兵大掠，坐不諫正，決杖五十。

translations.literal: When Zhizhong besieged Chuzhou he let his troops plunder greatly; for failing to remonstrate he was sentenced to fifty blows with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhizhong besieged Chuzhou and let his troops loot freely, Alibusun was punished with fifty strokes of the staff for failing to remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 大安初，改戶部員外郎、鈞州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Da'an he was changed to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and prefect of Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Da'an he became vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and prefect of Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 執中行樞密院於西京，複以為經歷官。

translations.literal: When Zhizhong conducted the itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs at the Western Capital, Alibusun was again made his staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhizhong ran the itinerant Bureau of Military Affairs at the Western Capital, Alibusun again served as his staff officer.

sentences.zh: 改威州刺史。

translations.literal: He was changed to prefect of Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，累遷國子祭酒，曆越王、濮王傅，改同知平陽府事，兼本路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyou he rose through posts to libationer of the National University, tutor to the Princes of Yue and Pu, deputy prefect of Pingyang while also deputy pacification commissioner of that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou he rose to libationer of the National University, tutor to the Princes of Yue and Pu, and deputy prefect of Pingyang with concurrent deputy pacification commissioner of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 召為兵部侍郎，遷翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: He was summoned as vice minister of war and transferred to Hanlin attendant academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was called to court as vice minister of war and made Hanlin attendant academician.

sentences.zh: 改陝西路宣撫副使，遷元帥左都監。

translations.literal: He was changed to deputy pacification commissioner of Shaanxi West Route and transferred to left overseer of field marshals.
translations.idiomatic: He became deputy pacification commissioner of Shaanxi West Route and left overseer of field marshals.

sentences.zh: 改河平軍節度使、河北西路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to military commissioner of Heping Army and deputy pacification commissioner of Hebei West Route.
translations.idiomatic: He was made commissioner of Heping Army and deputy pacification commissioner of Hebei West Route.

sentences.zh: 改禦史中丞、遼東宣撫副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to censor-in-chief and deputy pacification commissioner of Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: He became censor-in-chief and deputy pacification commissioner of Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 再閱月，權右副元帥、參知政事、遼東路行尚書省事，賜禦衣、廄馬、安山甲。

translations.literal: After two months he was acting right vice marshal, participant in governance, and conductor of the itinerant Secretariat on Liaodong Route; he was granted imperial robes, stable horses, and Anshan armor.
translations.idiomatic: Two months later he was acting right vice marshal, participant in governance, and head of the itinerant Secretariat on Liaodong Route; the court gave him imperial robes, stable horses, and Anshan armor.

sentences.zh: 上京行省蒲察五斤奏其功，賜金百兩、絹百匹。

translations.literal: The Upper Capital Branch Secretariat Pucha Wujin memorialized his merit; he was granted a hundred taels of gold and a hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Wujin of the Upper Capital Branch Secretariat reported his achievements; he received a hundred taels of gold and a hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 興定元年，真拜參知政事，權右副元帥，行尚書省、元帥府于婆速路，承制除拜剌史以下。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingding he was formally appointed participant in governance and acting right vice marshal, conducting the itinerant Secretariat and marshal's headquarters on Bosu Route with authority to appoint and dismiss clerks and cishi below.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xingding he was formally made participant in governance and acting right vice marshal, heading the itinerant Secretariat and marshal's headquarters on Bosu Route with power to appoint and remove officials up through prefect and cishi.

sentences.zh: 不協。

translations.literal: They were not in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: They were not in harmony.

sentences.zh: 是時，蒲鮮萬奴據遼東，侵掠婆速之境，高麗畏其強，助糧八萬石。

translations.literal: At that time Puxian Wannu held Liaodong and raided Bosu territory; Goryeo feared his strength and supplied eighty thousand dan of grain.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Puxian Wannu held Liaodong and raided Bosu; Goryeo, fearing his power, sent eighty thousand dan of grain.

sentences.zh: 上京行省蒲察五斤入朝，遼東兵勢愈弱，五斤留江山守肇州，江山亦頗懷去就。

translations.literal: Pucha Wujin of the Upper Capital Branch Secretariat came to court; Liaodong military strength grew weaker; Wujin left Jiangshan to guard Zhao prefecture, and Jiangshan too harbored thoughts of leaving.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Wujin of the Upper Capital Branch Secretariat went to court; Liaodong forces grew weaker; Wujin left Jiangshan to hold Zhao prefecture, and Jiangshan himself wavered in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 及上京宣撫使蒲察移刺都改陝西行省參議官，而伯德胡土遂有異志。

translations.literal: When Upper Capital pacification commissioner Pucha Yiliedu was changed to Shaanxi Branch Secretariat councillor, Bode Hutu then harbored dissenting intent.
translations.idiomatic: When Upper Capital Pacification Commissioner Pucha Yiliedu was moved to Shaanxi Branch Secretariat councillor, Bode Hutu began to harbor disloyal designs.

sentences.zh: 宣撫使海奴不迎制使，坐而受詔，阿里不孫械系之。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Hainu did not meet the commissioner bearing credentials but sat and received the edict; Alibusun had him bound in fetters.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Hainu would not go out to meet the credential-bearing commissioner and instead sat to receive the edict; Alibusun had him shackled.

sentences.zh: 頃之，阿里不孫輒矯制大赦諸道，眾乃稍安，而請罪於朝。

translations.literal: Before long Alibusun on his own authority proclaimed a general amnesty for the circuits; the masses were somewhat calmed, and he requested punishment from court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Alibusun on his own authority proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the circuits; the people were somewhat reassured, and he asked the court to punish him.

sentences.zh: 初，留哥據廣甯，知廣寧府事溫蒂罕青狗居蓋州，妻子留廣甯，與伯德胡土約為兄弟。

translations.literal: Earlier Liuge held Guangning; Wentihen Qinggou, who knew affairs of Guangning prefecture, dwelt at Gaizhou with wife and children left at Guangning, and with Bode Hutu swore brotherhood.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Liuge held Guangning; Wentihen Qinggou, who managed Guangning prefectural affairs, lived at Gaizhou while his wife and children remained in Guangning, and he had sworn brotherhood with Bode Hutu.

sentences.zh: 青狗兵隸阿里不孫，內猜忌不協，蒲察移剌都嘗奏青狗無隸阿里不孫。

translations.literal: Qinggou's troops were subject to Alibusun; within, suspicion and discord grew; Pucha Yiliedu once memorialized that Qinggou should not be subordinate to Alibusun.
translations.idiomatic: Qinggou's troops were under Alibusun, but mutual suspicion bred discord; Pucha Yiliedu had once memorialized that Qinggou ought not serve under Alibusun.

sentences.zh: 宣宗乃召青狗，青狗不受詔，阿里不孫殺之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong then summoned Qinggou; Qinggou would not accept the summons; Alibusun killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong then summoned Qinggou, but Qinggou refused the summons; Alibusun put him to death.

sentences.zh: 胡土乃怨阿里不孫。

translations.literal: Hutu then resented Alibusun.
translations.idiomatic: Hutu then came to hate Alibusun.

sentences.zh: 既而胡土率眾伐高麗，乃以兵戕殺阿里不孫。

translations.literal: Before long Hutu led his force to attack Goryeo and with troops slew Alibusun.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Hutu led his troops against Goryeo and killed Alibusun by force of arms.

sentences.zh: 權左都監納坦裕與監軍溫蒂罕哥不靄、遙授東平判官參議軍事郭澍謀誅胡土，未敢發，會上京留守蒲察五斤遣副留守夾穀愛答、左右司員外郎抹撚獨魯詣裕計事。

translations.literal: Acting Left Supervisor Natanyu with military inspector Wentihen Kebuai and remotely appointed Dongping judge and military affairs adviser Guo Shu plotted to kill Hutu but did not dare act; it happened that Upper Capital acting regent Pucha Wujin sent deputy regent Jiagu Aida and Left and Right Bureau assistant directors Monian Dulv to Yu to consult on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Left Supervisor Natanyu, Military Inspector Wentihen Kebuai, and Guo Shu—remotely appointed Dongping judge and military affairs adviser—plotted to kill Hutu but hesitated to strike. Just then Upper Capital Acting Regent Pucha Wujin sent Deputy Regent Jiagu Aida and Left and Right Bureau Assistant Directors Monian Dulv to Yu to discuss strategy.

sentences.zh: 裕以謀告二人，二人許諾，遂召胡土至帳中殺之。

translations.literal: Yu told the two men of the plot; the two promised; then they summoned Hutu to the tent and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu disclosed the plot to the two men; they agreed, summoned Hutu into the tent, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 阿里不孫已死，朝廷始得矯赦奏疏，詔有司獎諭。

translations.literal: Alibusun was already dead; the court could at last receive the forged amnesty memorial; an edict ordered the relevant offices to reward and commend.
translations.idiomatic: With Alibusun already dead, the court at last received the memorial reporting his forged amnesty edict and ordered the relevant offices to reward those involved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，聞阿里不孫死于亂，詔贈平章政事、芮國公。

translations.literal: Before long, hearing that Alibusun had died in the turmoil, an edict posthumously granted him Grand Councilor and Duke of Rui.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, when word came that Alibusun had died in the upheaval, the court posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Councilor and Duke of Rui.

sentences.zh: 納合裕真授左都監，哥不靄進一階，愛答、獨魯、郭澍遷官升職有差。

translations.literal: Nahe Yu was truly appointed Left Supervisor; Kebuai advanced one rank; Aida, Dulv, and Guo Shu were transferred and promoted in office with differences.
translations.idiomatic: Nahe Yu was formally appointed Left Supervisor; Kebuai was promoted one rank; and Aida, Dulv, and Guo Shu were transferred and promoted to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 阿里不孫寬厚愛人，敏于吏事，能治劇要，識者以為用之未盡雲。

translations.literal: Alibusun was generous and loving toward others, quick in administrative affairs, able to handle urgent and weighty matters; observers thought his talents had not been fully used—so they said.
translations.idiomatic: Alibusun was magnanimous and caring, deft in administration, and equal to the heaviest duties; those who knew him felt his abilities had never been fully put to use.

sentences.zh: 完顏鐵哥

translations.literal: Wanyan Tiege
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Tiege

sentences.zh: 完顏鐵哥，性淳直，體貌雄偉，粗通書。

translations.literal: Wanyan Tiege's nature was plain and upright; his physique was imposing; he had rough knowledge of writing.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Tiege was plainspoken and upright, imposing in stature, and had a modest literary education.

sentences.zh: 年二十四，襲父速頻路曷懶合打猛安。

translations.literal: At age twenty-four he succeeded his father as colony commander of Yelü Heda in the Sufin Route.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-four he inherited his father's post as colony commander of Yelü Heda on the Sufin Route.

sentences.zh: 授廣威將軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed General of Expansive Might.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed General of Expansive Might.

sentences.zh: 禦下惠愛。

translations.literal: In governing those below him he was kind and caring.
translations.idiomatic: He treated those under his command with kindness and care.

sentences.zh: 察廉，除臨海軍節度副使，改底剌颭詳穩。

translations.literal: Noted for integrity, he was appointed deputy military governor of Linhai Army; he was changed to Dilazhan regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Recognized for integrity, he was made deputy military governor of the Linhai Army, then transferred to regional commander at Dilazhan.

sentences.zh: 丞相襄行省于北京，鐵哥為先鋒萬戶，有功。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Xiang held a branch secretariat at Beijing, Tiege served as vanguard ten-thousand-household commander and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Chancellor Xiang directed affairs from a branch secretariat at Beijing, Tiege served as vanguard commander of ten thousand households and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服除，遷同知武勝軍節度使事，充右副元帥完顏匡副統，號平南蕩江將軍。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his mother; when mourning ended he was moved to associate military governor of Wusheng Army, filled the post of deputy commander under Right Deputy Marshal Wanyan Kuang, and was styled General Who Pacifies the South and Sweeps the Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: After observing mourning for his mother, he was appointed associate military governor of the Wusheng Army and served as deputy commander under Right Deputy Marshal Wanyan Kuang, taking the title General Who Pacifies the South and Sweeps the Rivers.

sentences.zh: 攻光化軍，王統制以步騎出東門逆戰，鐵哥擊卻之，拔鹿角，奪門以入，遂克之。

translations.literal: Attacking Guanghua Army, Commander Wang led infantry and cavalry out the east gate to meet battle; Tiege struck and repelled them, pulled up the abatis, seized the gate to enter, and thus took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Guanghua Army, Commander Wang led infantry and cavalry out the east gate to meet him; Tiege drove them back, tore out the abatis, forced the gate, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 進攻襄陽，為前驅，獲生口，知江渡可涉處，陰植標以識之。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Xiangyang, he served as vanguard, captured prisoners, learned where the river crossing could be forded, and secretly planted markers to mark them.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Xiangyang as vanguard, he took prisoners, learned where the river could be forded, and quietly set markers to guide the crossing.

sentences.zh: 大軍至，鐵哥導之濟，屢戰皆捷，以勞進官兩階。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, Tiege guided them across; battle after battle was victorious; for his labor he advanced two ranks in office.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, Tiege led them across; battle after battle went their way, and he was promoted two ranks for his service.

sentences.zh: 匡圍德安，鐵哥總領攻城，築壘于德安南鳳凰台，並城作甬道，立鵝車，對樓攻之，擊走張統制兵。

translations.literal: Kuang besieged De'an; Tiege took overall charge of the assault, built ramparts south of De'an at Phoenix Terrace, ran a corridor against the wall, erected battering rams and facing towers to attack, and struck and drove off Commander Zhang's troops.
translations.idiomatic: While Kuang besieged De'an, Tiege directed the assault, building earthworks south of the city at Phoenix Terrace, pushing a covered corridor against the wall, raising battering rams and siege towers, and driving off Commander Zhang's force.

sentences.zh: 時暑，還屯鄧州。

translations.literal: It was hot season; he returned to garrison at Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the heat of summer he withdrew to garrison Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 兵罷，進官兩階，遷同知臨潢府事，改西南路副招討、宿州防禦使。

translations.literal: When the army stood down he advanced two ranks in office, was moved to associate prefect of Linhuang, and was changed to Southwest Route deputy pacification commissioner and defensive commissioner of Su Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the campaign ended he was promoted two ranks, appointed associate prefect of Linhuang, and transferred to deputy pacification commissioner on the Southwest Route and defensive commissioner of Su Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 貞祐二年，樞密使徒單度移剌以鐵哥充都統，入衛中都。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou, Privy Councilor Tushan Duyila had Tiege fill the post of commander-in-chief to enter and guard the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou, Privy Councilor Tushan Duyila appointed Tiege commander-in-chief to enter the capital and guard Zhongdu.

sentences.zh: 遷東北路招討使，兼德昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was moved to pacification commissioner of the Northeast Route, concurrently military governor of Dechang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made pacification commissioner of the Northeast Route and concurrent military governor of the Dechang Army.

sentences.zh: 蒲鮮萬奴在咸平，忌鐵哥兵強，牒取所部騎兵二千，又召泰州軍三千及戶口遷咸平。

translations.literal: Puxian Wannu was at Xianping and resented Tiege's strong troops; by dispatch he took two thousand cavalry of his command, and also summoned three thousand Taizhou troops and households to relocate to Xianping.
translations.idiomatic: Puxian Wannu, holding Xianping, resented Tiege's strength and by official notice demanded two thousand of his cavalry; he also ordered three thousand Taizhou troops and their households transferred to Xianping.

sentences.zh: 鐵哥察其有異志，不遣。

translations.literal: Tiege perceived that he harbored a different intent and did not send them.
translations.idiomatic: Tiege saw disloyal designs in this and refused to comply.

sentences.zh: 宣撫使承充召鐵哥赴上京，命伐蒲與路。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Chengchong summoned Tiege to the Upper Capital and ordered him to attack the Puyu Route.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Chengchong summoned Tiege to the Upper Capital and ordered him to campaign against the Puyu Route.

sentences.zh: 既還，適萬奴代承充為宣撫使，摭前不發軍罪，下獄被害。

translations.literal: After he returned, it happened that Wannu replaced Chengchong as pacification commissioner, seized on the earlier offense of not sending troops, put him in prison, and he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On his return, Wannu had just replaced Chengchong as pacification commissioner; he dredged up Tiege's refusal to send troops, threw him into prison, and had him killed.

sentences.zh: 諡勇毅。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Yongyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Yongyi (Brave and Resolute).

sentences.zh: 納蘭胡魯剌

translations.literal: Nalan Hulula
translations.idiomatic: Nalan Hulula

sentences.zh: 納蘭胡魯剌，大名路怕魯歡猛安人。

translations.literal: Nalan Hulula was a man of the Baluhuan colony commander in Daming Route.
translations.idiomatic: Nalan Hulula came from the Baluhuan colony command in Daming Route.

sentences.zh: 性淳直，寡言笑，好讀書，博通今古。

translations.literal: His nature was plain and upright; he spoke little and laughed little; he loved reading books and was broadly versed in past and present.
translations.idiomatic: Plainspoken and upright, he spoke and laughed little, loved books, and was widely learned in affairs past and present.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，進士第一，除應奉翰林文字。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an he placed first among jinshi graduates and was appointed Hanlin drafting attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an he took first place among jinshi graduates and was appointed Hanlin drafting attendant.

sentences.zh: 被詔括牛於臨潢、上京等路。

translations.literal: He received an edict to register cattle in the Linhuang, Upper Capital, and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he was sent to register cattle in the Linhuang, Upper Capital, and other routes.

sentences.zh: 丞相襄有田在肇州，家奴匿牛不以實聞，即械繫正其罪而盡括之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Xiang had fields in Zhao Prefecture; a household slave hid cattle and did not report the true count; he immediately had him shackled, corrected his crime, and fully registered them.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Xiang held land in Zhao Prefecture, but his household slaves concealed cattle from the register; Hulula had them shackled, punished the offense, and registered every head.

sentences.zh: 於是豪民皆懼，無敢匿者。

translations.literal: Thereupon powerful families were all afraid; none dared conceal.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families were terrified, and none dared conceal stock any longer.

sentences.zh: 使還，襄稱其能。

translations.literal: When the mission returned, Xiang praised his ability.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned from the mission, Xiang praised his competence.

sentences.zh: 居父喪盡禮，御史舉其清節。

translations.literal: In dwelling in mourning for his father he fulfilled all rites; the censorate recommended his pure integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He observed his father's mourning to the letter, and the censorate commended his integrity.

sentences.zh: 服除，轉修撰。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was transferred to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was made a compiler.

sentences.zh: 平章政事僕散端舉廉能有文采，遷同知順天軍節度使事，從伐宋。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Pusan Duan recommended him for integrity, ability, and literary talent; he was moved to associate military governor of Shuntian Army and followed the campaign against Song.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Pusan Duan recommended him for integrity, ability, and literary talent; he was appointed associate military governor of the Shuntian Army and joined the campaign against Song.

sentences.zh: 以勞加朝請大夫，改禮部員外郎、曹州刺史。

translations.literal: For his labor he was given the added title Court Gentleman for Appearances; he was changed to Ministry of Rites assistant director and prefect of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was given the honorary title Court Gentleman for Appearances and appointed assistant director in the Ministry of Rites and prefect of Cao.

sentences.zh: 豪民僕散掃合立私渡于定陶間，逃兵盜劫，皆籍為囊橐，累政莫敢問。

translations.literal: A powerful man, Pusan Saoge, established a private ferry between Dingtao; deserters and bandits all counted it as their purse; successive administrations did not dare inquire.
translations.idiomatic: A local magnate, Pusan Saoge, ran an illegal ferry near Dingtao; deserters and robbers treated it as their purse, and administration after administration had left it alone.

sentences.zh: 胡魯剌捕治之，窮竟其黨，闔郡肅然。

translations.literal: Hulula arrested and punished them, thoroughly investigated his faction, and the whole commandery became orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Hulula arrested and prosecuted them, rooted out the whole faction, and the commandery grew quiet.

sentences.zh: 改沃州。

translations.literal: He was changed to Wo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Wo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改南京路按察副使。

translations.literal: He was changed to surveillance vice-commissioner of Nanjing Route.
translations.idiomatic: He was made surveillance vice-commissioner of the Nanjing Route.

sentences.zh: 貞佑二年，改泗州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyou he was changed to defensive commissioner of Si Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenyou he was appointed defensive commissioner of Si Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召為吏部侍郎，遷絳陽軍節度使，權河東南路宣撫副使。

translations.literal: He was summoned as vice director of the Ministry of Personnel; he was moved to military governor of Jiangyang Army and acting pacification vice-commissioner of Hedong South Route.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as vice director of the Ministry of Personnel, then made military governor of the Jiangyang Army and acting pacification vice-commissioner of the Hedong South Route.

sentences.zh: 是時兵興，胡魯剌完城郭，繕器械，料丁壯為鄉兵。

translations.literal: At that time warfare had arisen; Hulula completed walls and cities, repaired weapons and equipment, and mustered able-bodied men as local militia.
translations.idiomatic: With war underway, Hulula repaired walls and cities, readied arms, and mustered able-bodied men into local militia.

sentences.zh: 延問耆老，招致儒士，咨以備禦之策。

translations.literal: He extended inquiry to elders, invited Confucian scholars, and consulted them on strategies for defense preparations.
translations.idiomatic: He sought out elders, gathered scholars, and asked their counsel on defense.

sentences.zh: 鹽米儲偫，勸富民出粟，郡賴以完。

translations.literal: He stored salt and grain in reserve, urged wealthy households to release grain, and the commandery relied on this to remain intact.
translations.idiomatic: He stockpiled salt and grain, urged wealthy households to contribute grain, and the commandery weathered the crisis intact.

sentences.zh: 賜詔褒諭，加資善大夫，官其次子吾申。

translations.literal: He was granted an edict of praise and commendation, given the added title Master of Support for Goodness, and his second son Wushen was given office.
translations.idiomatic: The throne issued a commendatory edict, raised him to Master Who Supports Goodness, and enfeoffed his second son Wushen.

sentences.zh: 改權經略使，被召，以疾不能行，卒於絳州。

translations.literal: He was changed to acting military affairs commissioner; he was summoned but, because of illness, could not go; he died at Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was made acting military affairs commissioner and summoned to court, but illness kept him from traveling, and he died at Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：泰和、貞祐，其間相去五年耳，故將遺老往往在焉。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Taihe and Zhenyou—between them only five years apart—yet veteran generals and surviving elders were often still there.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: Between the Taihe and Zhenyou eras lay only five years, yet veteran commanders and surviving elders were still to be found.

sentences.zh: 高琪得君，宿將皆斥外矣。

translations.literal: When Gao Qi won the ruler's favor, veteran generals were all expelled to the outer posts.
translations.idiomatic: Once Gao Qi won the emperor's favor, veteran generals were all pushed to the margins.

sentences.zh: 高汝礪任職，舊臣皆守籓矣。

translations.literal: When Gao Rushi took office, old ministers all held regional posts.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Rushi took office, the old ministers were all kept on regional duty.

sentences.zh: 假以重任，其實疏之。

translations.literal: They were lent heavy responsibility, but in truth were kept at a distance.
translations.idiomatic: They were given grand titles in name while in truth being held at arm's length.

sentences.zh: 故石抹仲溫以下，以見當時之將校焉。

translations.literal: Therefore from Shimo Zhongwen downward, one may see the commanders and officers of that time.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the figures from Shimo Zhongwen onward show what the empire's commanders and officers looked like in that age.
